verses.heading: I / I
verses.text: THE VISION OF ISAIAH THE SON OF AMOZ, WHICH HE SAW CONCERNING JUDAH AND JERUSALEM; IN THE DAYS OF UZZIAH, JOTHAM, AHAZ, HEZEEIAH, KINGS OF JUDAH.
Hear, O ye heavens; and give ear, O earth: For Jehovah speaketh. I have nourished and brought up children; And they have rebelled against me.
verses.html:
Hear, O ye heavens; and give ear, O earth:
For Jehovah speaketh.
I have nourished and brought up children;
And they have rebelled against me.

verses.text: The ox knoweth his owner, And the ass his master's crib: But Israel doth not know; My people doth not consider.
verses.html:
The ox knoweth his owner, And the ass his master's crib:
But Israel doth not know;
My people doth not consider.

verses.text: Wo to the sinful nation, people laden with iniquity, Seed of evil-doers, children that are corrupters: They have forsaken Jehovah, They have despised the Holy One of Israel; They are gone away backward.
verses.html:
Wo to the sinful nation, people laden with iniquity, Seed of evil-doers, children that are corrupters:
They have forsaken Jehovah,
They have despised the Holy One of Israel;
They are gone away backward.

verses.text: Upon what part will ye be smitten any more, should you still revolt? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint:
From the sole of the foot even unto the crown of the head, there is no soundness; But wounds, and lashes, and fresh stripes: They have not been pressed out, neither bound up, Nor mollified with oil.
verses.html:
From the sole of the foot even unto the crown of the head, there is no soundness;
But wounds, and lashes, and fresh stripes:
They have not been pressed out, neither bound up,
Nor mollified with oil.

verses.text: Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire; Your land, strangers devour it before your eyes; It is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
And the daughter of Zion is left alone, as a shed in a vineyard; As a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a city that is saved.
Except Jehovah of hosts had left unto us the smallest remnant, We had been as Sodom, we had become like unto Gomorrah.
verses.html:
Except Jehovah of hosts had left unto us the smallest remnant,
We had been as Sodom, we had become like unto Gomorrah.

verses.text: Hear ye the word of Jehovah, O ye princes of Sodom! Give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah!
verses.html:
Hear ye the word of Jehovah, O ye princes of Sodom!
Give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah!

verses.text: Why to me is the multitude of your sacrifices? saith Jehovah: I am cloyed with the burnt-offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; And in the blood of bullocks, and of lambs, and of he-goats, I have no delight.
verses.html:
Why to me is the multitude of your sacrifices? saith Jehovah:
I am cloyed with the burnt-offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts;
And in the blood of bullocks, and of lambs, and of he-goats, I have no delight.

verses.text: When ye come to appear before me, Who hath required this at your hand, to tread my courts?
Bring no more insincere oblation, Incense! it is an abomination unto me; The new moon, the sabbath, and the proclaiming of an assembly, I cannot endure: it is iniquity, even the solemn assembly.
verses.html:
Bring no more insincere oblation, Incense! it is an abomination unto me; The new moon, the sabbath, and the proclaiming of an assembly,
I cannot endure: it is iniquity, even the solemn assembly.

verses.text: Your new moons, and your appointed festivals, my soul hateth: They are a burden unto me; I am weary of bearing them.
And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you; Even when ye multiply prayer, I will not hear: Your hands are full of blood.
Wash ye, make ye clean; Remove ye far away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; Cease to do evil:
Learn to do good; seek after justice; correct the evil-doer; Do justice to the orphan; plead for the widow.
Come now, and let us reason together, saith Jehovah: Though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be white as snow; Though they be red as crimson, they shall be as wool.
verses.html:
Come now, and let us reason together, saith Jehovah:
Though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be white as snow;
Though they be red as crimson, they shall be as wool.

verses.text: If ye be willing and obedient, Ye shall eat the good of the land;
But if ye refuse and rebel, Ye shall be devoured with the sword: For the mouth of Jehovah hath spoken it.
verses.html:
But if ye refuse and rebel, Ye shall be devoured with the sword:
For the mouth of Jehovah hath spoken it.

verses.text: How is the faithful city become an harlot! She that was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in her; But now murderers!
Thy silver is become dross; Thy wine mixed with water.

Thy princes are rebellious, and associates of robbers; Every one of them loveth a bribe, and hunteth after rewards: For the orphan they procure no justice; And the cause of the widow cometh not before them.
Wherefore saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, the mighty One of Israel: Ah! I will ease me of mine adversaries, And avenge me of mine enemies.
verses.html:
Wherefore saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, the mighty One of Israel:
Ah! I will ease me of mine adversaries,
And avenge me of mine enemies.

verses.text: And I will direct mine hand against thee, And entirely melt out thy dross, And remove all thy tin:
And I will restore thy judges, as at the first; And thy counsellors, as at the beginning: Afterward thou shalt be called, The town of righteousness, the faithful city.
Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, And those that return unto her, with righteousness.
But the destruction of revolters and of sinners shall be together; And they that forsake Jehovah shall perish.
verses.html:
But the destruction of revolters and of sinners shall be together;
And they that forsake Jehovah shall perish.

verses.text: Then shall men be ashamed of the grove of teberinths, which are your delight; And ye shall blush for the gardens, which ye have loved:
For ye shall be as the teberinth, whose leaves are withered; And as a garden, wherein there is no water.
The powerful shall become as tow, And his work as a spark of fire; And they shall burn both of them together; and none shall quench them.
verses.html:
The powerful shall become as tow, And his work as a spark of fire;
And they shall burn both of them together; and none shall quench them.

verses.heading: II / II
verses.text: THE WORD WHICH WAS REVEALED UNTO ISAIAH, THE SON OF AMOZ, CONCERNING JUDAH AND JERUSALEM.

It shall come to pass in the last days, That the mountain of the house of Jehovah shall be established on the top of the mountains; And it shall be exalted above the hills: And all the nations shall flow unto it.
verses.html:
It shall come to pass in the last days,
That the mountain of the house of Jehovah shall be established on the top of the mountains;
And it shall be exalted above the hills:
And all the nations shall flow unto it.

verses.text: And many people shall go, and say; Come on, and let us go up to the mountain of Jehovah; To the house of the God of Jacob: And he will teach us of his ways; And we will walk in his paths: For from Zion shall go forth the law; And the word of Jehovah from Jerusalem.
verses.html:
And many people shall go, and say;
Come on, and let us go up to the mountain of Jehovah;
To the house of the God of Jacob:
And he will teach us of his ways;
And we will walk in his paths:
For from Zion shall go forth the law;
And the word of Jehovah from Jerusalem.

verses.text: And he shall judge among the nations, And give sentence to many people: And they shall beat their swords into ploughshares, And their spears into pruning-hooks: Nation shall not lift up sword against nation; Neither shall they learn war any more.
O house of Jacob, come ye, And let us walk in the light of Jehovah.
verses.html:
O house of Jacob, come ye,
And let us walk in the light of Jehovah.

verses.text: Therefore thou hast abandoned thy people, the house of Jacob, Because they are full of the East, And are soothsayers like the Philistines; And they join hand in hand with the children of strangers.
Their land is full of silver and gold; And there is no end to their treasures: Their land is full of horses: And there is no end to their chariots.
Their land is full of idols; Before the work of their own hands do they prostrate themselves; Before that which their own fingers have made.
Wherefore the mean man is bowed down, and the great man is humbled; And thou wilt not forgive them.
Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust; For fear of Jehovah, and for the glory of his majesty.
verses.html:
Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust;
For fear of Jehovah, and for the glory of his majesty.

verses.text: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, And the haughtiness of mortals shall be bowed down: And Jehovah alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.html:
The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, And the haughtiness of mortals shall be bowed down:
And Jehovah alone shall be exalted in that day.

verses.text: For there is unto Jehovah of hosts a day against every thing proud and lofty; And against every thing exalted, that it shall be humbled.
verses.html:
For there is unto Jehovah of hosts a day against every thing proud and lofty;
And against every thing exalted, that it shall be humbled.

verses.text: Even against all the cedars of Lebanon, the high and the exalted; And against all the oaks of Bashan:
And against all the high mountains, And against all the exalted hills:
And against every high raised tower; And against every fenced wall.
And against all the ships of Tarshish; And against every desirable work of art.
And the pride of man shall be bowed down, And the haughtiness of mortals shall be humbled; And Jehovah alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.html:
And the pride of man shall be bowed down, And the haughtiness of mortals shall be humbled;
And Jehovah alone shall be exalted in that day.

verses.text: And the idols shall be utterly destroyed.
And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth; For fear of Jehovah, and for the glory of his majesty, When he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
verses.html:
And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth;
For fear of Jehovah, and for the glory of his majesty,
When he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.

verses.text: In that day shall men cast away their idols of silver, And their idols of gold, which they had made for themselves to worship, To the moles and to the bats:
To go into the caves of the rocks, and into the clefts of the craggy rocks: For fear of Jehovah, and for the glory of his majesty, When he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
verses.html:
To go into the caves of the rocks, and into the clefts of the craggy rocks:
For fear of Jehovah, and for the glory of his majesty,
When he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.

verses.text: Cease ye from trust in man, whose breath is in his nostrils; For wherein is he of any account?

verses.heading: III / III
verses.text: For, behold, the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, Removeth from Jerusalem, and from Judah, Every stay and support; The whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water:
verses.html:
For, behold, the Lord, Jehovah of hosts,
Removeth from Jerusalem, and from Judah,
Every stay and support;
The whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water:

verses.text: The mighty man, and the warrior; The judge, and the prophet, and the diviner, and the elder:
The captain of fifty, and the honourable man; And the counsellor, and the cunning artificer, and the skilful in incantation.
And I will set boys for their princes; And children shall rule over them.
And the people shall be oppressed; This man by that man, and that man by his neighbour: They shall behave themselves insolently, the boy towards the old man; And the base towards the honourable.
Then should a man lay hold on his brother, of the house of his father, Saying, thou hast raiment; be thou ruler over us, And take this ruin under thy hand:
verses.html:
Then should a man lay hold on his brother, of the house of his father,
Saying, thou hast raiment; be thou ruler over us,
And take this ruin under thy hand:

verses.text: He shall swear in that day, saying, I cannot be the healer; For in my house is neither bread nor raiment: Appoint not me a ruler of the people.
For Jerusalem tottereth, and Judah falleth; Because their tongue and their deeds are against Jehovah; To provoke his glorious eyes.
verses.html:
For Jerusalem tottereth, and Judah falleth; Because their tongue and their deeds are against
Jehovah;
To provoke his glorious eyes.

verses.text: The shamelessness of their countenances witnesseth against them; And they speak openly of their sin, like Sodom, they hide it not: Wo unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.
Say ye to the righteous, that it shall be well with him; For the fruit of his deeds shall he eat.
verses.html:
Say ye to the righteous, that it shall be well with him;
For the fruit of his deeds shall he eat.

verses.text: Wo unto the wicked, it shall be ill with him; For the reward of his hands shall be given him.
verses.html:
Wo unto the wicked, it shall be ill with him;
For the reward of his hands shall be given him.

verses.text: As for my people, children are their oppressors; And women rule over them. O my people, thy leaders cause thee to err; And the way of thy paths, they pervert.
Jehovah ariseth to plead his cause; He standeth to judge the people.
verses.html:
Jehovah ariseth to plead his cause;
He standeth to judge the people.

verses.text: Jehovah will enter into judgment With the elders of his people and their princes: For ye have consumed the vineyard, The plunder of the poor is in your houses.
verses.html:
Jehovah will enter into judgment
With the elders of his people and their princes:
For ye have consumed the vineyard,
The plunder of the poor is in your houses.

verses.text: What mean ye that ye crush my people, And grind the faces of the poor? Saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts.
verses.html:
What mean ye that ye crush my people, And grind the faces of the poor?
Saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts.

verses.text: Moreover Jehovah hath said: Because the daughters of Zion ore haughty; And walk displaying the neck, And leering with their eyes, Walking and mincing as they go, And making a tinkling with their feet.
verses.html:
Moreover Jehovah hath said:
Because the daughters of Zion ore haughty;
And walk displaying the neck,
And leering with their eyes,
Walking and mincing as they go,
And making a tinkling with their feet.

verses.text: Therefore will the Lord smite with a scab the head of the daughters of Zion; And Jehovah will expose their nakedness.
verses.html:
Therefore will the Lord smite with a scab the head of the daughters of Zion;
And Jehovah will expose their nakedness.

verses.text: In that day will the Lord remove the splendour of the foot-ornaments, And the caps of network, and the crescents;
The ear-pendents, and the bracelets, and the thin veils;
The head-dress, and the ornaments of the legs, and the girdles, And the perfume-boxes, and the amulets;
The rings, and the jewels of the nose;
The embroidered robes, and the tunics; And the cloaks, and the sachels;
The transparent garments, and the fine linen vests; And the turbans, and the mantles.

And it shall come to pass, that instead of perfume there shall be a stench; And instead of a girdle, a rope; And instead of plaited hair, baldness; And instead of a stomacher, a girding of sackcloth: A sunburnt skin, instead of beauty.
Thy men shall fall by the sword; And thy mighty in the war,
And her gates shall lament and mourn; And destitute shall she sit upon the ground.

verses.heading: IV / IV
verses.text: And seven women shall lay hold on one man in that day, saying: We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel; Only let us be called by thy name, To take away our reproach.
In that day shall the Branch of Jehovah Become beautiful and glorious; And the fruit of the earth excellent and comely, For the remnant saved of Israel.
verses.html:
In that day shall the Branch of Jehovah
Become beautiful and glorious;
And the fruit of the earth excellent and comely,
For the remnant saved of Israel.

verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Zion, And he that remaineth in Jerusalem, Shall be called holy, Even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem.
verses.html:
And it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Zion, And he that remaineth in Jerusalem, Shall be called holy,
Even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem.

verses.text: When the Lord shall have Washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion; And shall have wiped off the blood of Jerusalem from the midst of her, By a spirit of judgment, and by a spirit of burning:

Then shall Jehovah create upon every dwelling-place in mount Zion, And upon her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day; And the brightness of a flaming fire by night: For upon all the glory there shall be a covering.
verses.html:
Then shall Jehovah create upon every dwelling-place in mount Zion,
And upon her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day;
And the brightness of a flaming fire by night:
For upon all the glory there shall be a covering.

verses.text: And a tabernacle it shall be for a shade by day from the heat; And for a place of refuge, and for a covert, from storm and from rain.

verses.heading: V / V
verses.text: Let me sing now to my Beloved, A song of my Beloved touching his vineyard. My Beloved had a vineyard Upon a very fruitful hill.

He digged it, and cleared it of stones, And planted it with the choicest vine, And he built a tower in the midst of it, And also hewed out a wine-vat therein; And he expected, that it should bring forth grapes; But it brought forth baneful berries.
And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and ye men of Judah, Judge, I pray you, between me and my vineyard.
What could have been done more to my vineyard, Than I have done unto it? Why, when I expected that it should bring forth grapes, Brought it forth baneful berries?
But come now, and I will make known unto you What I will do unto my vineyard I will remove its hedge, and it shall be eaten up; I will demolish its wall, and it shall be trodden down.
And I will make it a waste: It shall not be pruned, neither shall it be weeded; But there shall come up briers and thorns; And to the clouds I will give command, That they rain no rain upon it.
For the vineyard of Jehovah of hosts is the house of Israel; And the men of Judah his pleasant plant: He looked for judgment, and behold a shedding of blood; For justice, and behold a cry.
verses.html:
For the vineyard of Jehovah of hosts is the house of Israel;
And the men of Judah his pleasant plant:
He looked for judgment, and behold a shedding of blood;
For justice, and behold a cry.

verses.text: Wo unto them, who join house to house; Who lay field unto field together; Until there be no more room left, And ye dwell by yourselves alone in the midst of the land.
In my ears hath Jehovah of hosts revealed it: Surely, the many houses shall become a desolation; The great and the fair ones, no one shall inhabit.
verses.html:
In my ears hath Jehovah of hosts revealed it:
Surely, the many houses shall become a desolation;
The great and the fair ones, no one shall inhabit.

verses.text: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield but one bath, And a chomer of seed shall produce an ephah.
Wo unto them that rise up early in the morning to follow after strong drink; Who sit late in the evening, that the wine may inflame them:
And the lyre, and the harp, the tabor, and the pipe, And wine, are in their feasts; But the work of Jehovah they regard not; And the operation of his hands they do not perceive.
verses.html:
And the lyre, and the harp, the tabor, and the pipe, And wine, are in their feasts;
But the work of Jehovah they regard not;
And the operation of his hands they do not perceive.

verses.text: Therefore my people goeth into captivity by surprise; Their nobles die with hunger; And their multitude are parched up with thirst.
Therefore bath Hades opened its jaws with greediness; And hath stretched open its mouth without measure: And down go her nobility, and her multitude; And her busy throng, and all that exult in her.
And the mean man shall be bowed down, and the great man shall be humbled; And the eyes of the haughty are humbled.
But Jehovah of hosts shall be exalted in judgment; And the Holy God shall be sanctified in righteousness.
verses.html:
But Jehovah of hosts shall be exalted in judgment;
And the Holy God shall be sanctified in righteousness.

verses.text: Then shall the sheep feed, as upon their own pasture; And in the desolate possessions of the rich shall strange flocks graze.
Wo unto them that draw punishment along with a rope of vice; And destruction as with a cart-rope.
Who say, Let him make speed, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; And let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come to pass, that we may know it.
Wo unto them that call evil good, and good evil; Who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; Who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter.
Wo unto them that are wise in their own eyes; And prudent in their own conceit.
Wo unto them that are powerful to drink wine; And men of might to mingle strong drink.
Who justify the guilty for reward, And take away the righteousness of the righteous from him.

Therefore as the flame of fire devoureth the stubble, And as the dry grass sinketh down into the flame; So their root shall be as rottenness, And their blossom shall go up like the dust: Because they have despised the law of Jehovah of hosts; And scornfully rejected the word of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.html:
Therefore as the flame of fire devoureth the stubble, And as the dry grass sinketh down into the flame; So their root shall be as rottenness, And their blossom shall go up like the dust:
Because they have despised the law of Jehovah of hosts;
And scornfully rejected the word of the Holy One of Israel.

verses.text: Therefore is the anger of Jehovah kindled against his people; And he hath stretched out his hand against them, And smitten them; and the mountains trembled; And their carcases became as the mire in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away; But his hand is still stretched out.
verses.html:
Therefore is the anger of Jehovah kindled against his people;
And he hath stretched out his hand against them,
And smitten them; and the mountains trembled;
And their carcases became as the mire in the midst of the streets.
For all this his anger is not turned away;
But his hand is still stretched out.

verses.text: And he will erect a standard for the nations afar off; And he will hiss unto them from the end of the earth; And behold, with speed swiftly shall they come.
None among them is faint, and none stumbleth; No one slumbereth, and no one sleepeth: Neither is the girdle of their loins loosed, Nor the latchet of their shoes torn off.
Whose arrows are sharpened, And all their bows are bent: The hoofs of their horses are counted like unto the flint; And their wheels unto the whirlwind.
Their roaring is like that of the lioness; They roar like the young lions: They rage, and seize the prey; They bear it away, and no one doth rescue.
In that day shall they roar against them, like the roaring of the sea; And if one look unto the land, behold there darkness; Perplexity mid light; It becomes dark in the clouds thereof.

verses.heading: VI / VI
verses.text: In the year, in which Uzziab the king died, I saw the Lord sitting upon a throne high and lofty; and his train filled the temple.
Above him stood the Seraphim: each one of them had six wings: with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, mid with twain he did fly.
And the one called to the other, and said: Holy, holy, holy, is Jehovah of hosts! The whole earth is full of his glory.
verses.html:
And the one called to the other, and said:
Holy, holy, holy, is Jehovah of hosts!
The whole earth is full of his glory.

verses.text: And the foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him, who called; and the house was filled with smoke.
Then I said, Wo is me! I am undone: because I am a man of unclean lips; and in the midst of a people of unclean lips do i dwell: for mine eyes have seen the King, Jehovah of hosts.
verses.html: Then I said, Wo is me! I am undone: because I am a man of unclean lips; and in the midst of a people of unclean lips do i dwell: for mine eyes have seen the King, Jehovah of hosts.

verses.text: Then flew one of the Seraphim unto me; and in his hand was a burning coal, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.
And he touched my mouth, and said: Lo, this bath touched thy lips: thine iniquity is removed, and thy sin is expiated.
And I heard the voice of the Lord, saying: Whom shall I send; and who will go for us! And I said: Behold, here am I, send me.
And he said: Go, and say thou to this people: Hear ye distinctly, but ye shall not understand; See ye clearly, but ye shall not perceive;

Make gross the heart of this people; Make their ears dull, and close up their eyes; Lest they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, And understand with their hearts, and be converted, and be healed.
And I said; How long, Lord! And he said: Until the cities be laid waste, so that there be no inhabitant; And the houses, so that there be no man: And the land be left utterly desolate.
Then Jehovah will remove men far away; And great shall be the desolation in the midst of the land.
verses.html:
Then Jehovah will remove men far away;
And great shall be the desolation in the midst of the land.

verses.text: But should there still be left in it a tenth part, It would likewise be consumed; Yet, as the teberinth and the oak, when they are cut down, have their stem remaining; So also a holy seed, as a stem of the people, shall remain.
verses.html:
But should there still be left in it a tenth part, It would likewise be consumed;
Yet, as the teberinth and the oak, when they are cut down, have their stem remaining;
So also a holy seed, as a stem of the people, shall remain.

verses.heading: VII / VII
verses.text: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz, the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin king of Syria, and Pekah, the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up toward Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
And when it was told to the house of David, Syria is confederate with Ephraim: then his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest are moved before the wind.
And Jehovah said unto Isaiah: Go out now to meet Ahaz, thou and Shear-jeshub thy son, at the end of the aqueduct of the upper pool, at the causeway of the fuller’s field.
verses.html: And Jehovah said unto Isaiah: Go out now to meet Ahaz, thou and Shear-jeshub thy son, at the end of the aqueduct of the upper pool, at the causeway of the fuller’s field.

verses.text: And thou shalt say unto him: Take heed, and be still: fear not, neither let thy heart be faint, on account of these two tails of smoking firebrands; for the fierce wrath of Rezin, and Syria, and the son of Remaliah.
Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted mischief against thee, saying:
Let us go up against Judah, and besiege it; And let us divide it among ourselves: And let us set up a king in the midst of it; Even the son of Tabeal.
Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.
verses.html:
Thus saith the Lord Jehovah:
It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.

verses.text: Although the head of Syria be Damascus, And the head of Damascus, Rezin; Yet within three score and five years, Ephraim shall be broken, that he be no more a people:
Yea, although the head of Ephraim be Samaria; And the head of Samaria, Remaliah’s son. If ye believe not in me, surely ye shall not be established.
verses.html:
Yea, although the head of Ephraim be Samaria;
And the head of Samaria, Remaliah’s son.
If ye believe not in me, surely ye shall not be established.

verses.text: And Jehovah spoke yet again to Ahaz, saying:
verses.html: And Jehovah spoke yet again to Ahaz, saying:

verses.text: Ask for thee a sign from Jehovah thy God: Ask it in the deep, or seek it in the height above.
verses.html:
Ask for thee a sign from Jehovah thy God:
Ask it in the deep, or seek it in the height above.

verses.text: And Ahaz said: I will not ask, neither will I tempt Jehovah. And he said:
verses.html: And Ahaz said: I will not ask, neither will I tempt Jehovah. And he said:

verses.text: Hear ye now, O house of David: Is it a small thing for you to weary the patience of men, That you should weary ray God also?
Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign: Behold, the Virgin shall conceive, and bear a son; And she shall call his name Immanuel.
verses.html:
Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign: Behold, the Virgin shall conceive, and bear a son;
And she shall call his name Immanuel.

verses.text: Butter and honey shall he eat, Until he shall have knowledge to refuse the evil, and to choose the good:
For before the child shall have knowledge To refuse the evil, and to choose the good; The land, which causeth uneasiness unto thee By reason of its two kings, shall be deserted.
But Jehovah shall bring upon thee, And upon thy people, and upon thy father's house, Days, such as have not come, From the day that Ephraim departed from Judah; Namely, the king of Assyria.
verses.html:
But Jehovah shall bring upon thee,
And upon thy people, and upon thy father's house,
Days, such as have not come,
From the day that Ephraim departed from Judah;
Namely, the king of Assyria.

verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, That Jehovah shall hiss for the fly That is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt; And for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
verses.html:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
That Jehovah shall hiss for the fly
That is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt;
And for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.

verses.text: And they shall come, and they shall light all of them, On the valleys of the deserts, and on the clefts of the rocks, And on all the thorn-bushes, and upon all the meadows.
In that day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired From beyond the river; namely, with the king of Assyria, The head, and the hair of the feet; And the beard also it shall take away.
verses.html:
In that day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired
From beyond the river; namely, with the king of Assyria,
The head, and the hair of the feet;
And the beard also it shall take away.

verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, That a man shall keep one cow and two sheep;
And it shall be, From the plenty of milk which they shall give, he shall eat butter: Yea, butter and honey shall every one eat That is left in the midst of the land.
And it shall come to pass in that day, That every place, wherein there were a thousand vines At a thousand pieces of silver, Shall become the portion of briers and thorns.
With arrows and with the bow shall men come thither; For the whole land shall become briers and thorns.
And upon all the hills, which were dressed with the mattock, Will no one go, for fear of briers and thorns; But they shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of sheep.

verses.heading: VIII / VIII
verses.text: And Jehovah said unto me: Take unto thee a large roll; and write upon it, in the style of man, Hasten the spoil, take quickly the prey.
verses.html: And Jehovah said unto me: Take unto thee a large roll; and write upon it, in the style of man, Hasten the spoil, take quickly the prey.

verses.text: And I took unto me faithful witnesses; Uriah the priest, and Zachariah the son of Jerebechiah.
And I approached unto the prophetess; and she conceived and bare a son. And Jehovah said unto me: Call his name Maher-Shalal Hash-Baz.
verses.html: And I approached unto the prophetess; and she conceived and bare a son. And Jehovah said unto me: Call his name Maher-Shalal Hash-Baz.

verses.text: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father and My mother, the riches of Damascus, and the spoil of Samaria, shall be taken away before the face of the king of Assyria.
Yet again Jehovah spoke unto me, saying:
verses.html: Yet again Jehovah spoke unto me, saying:

verses.text: Because this people hath rejected The waters of Shiloah, which flow gently; And rejoiceth in Rezin, and the son of Remaliah:

Now, therefore, behold the Lord bringeth up upon them The waters of the river, strong and mighty; Even the king of Assyria, and all his glory: And he shall rise above all their channels, And go over all their banks.
And he shall pass through Judah, he shall overflow and go over; Even to the neck shall he reach: And the spreading of his wings shall be Over the full breadth of thy land, O Immanuel!
verses.html:
And he shall pass through Judah, he shall overflow and go over; Even to the neck shall he reach: And the spreading of his wings shall be
Over the full breadth of thy land, O Immanuel!

verses.text: Link yourselves together, O ye people, yet shall you be broken in pieces; And give ear, all ye distant lands: Gird ye yourselves, yet shall you be broken in pieces; Gird ye yourselves, yet shall you be broken in pieces.
Take counsel together, yet it shall be brought to nought; Speak the word, but it shall not stand; For God is with us.
For thus said Jehovah unto me, with a strong hand, When he warned me against walking in the way of this people, saying:
verses.html:
For thus said Jehovah unto me, with a strong hand,
When he warned me against walking in the way of this people, saying:

verses.text: Call ye not that a confederacy, Whatsoever this people shall call a confederacy: And be ye not afraid of their fear, neither be ye terrified.
Jehovah of hosts, Him sanctify; And let him be your fear, and let him be your terror.
verses.html:
Jehovah of hosts, Him sanctify;
And let him be your fear, and let him be your terror.

verses.text: And he shall be unto you for a sanctuary: But for a stone of stumbling, and for a rock of offence. To both the houses of Israel; For a trap, and for a snare, to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.html:
And he shall be unto you for a sanctuary:
But for a stone of stumbling, and for a rock of offence.
To both the houses of Israel;
For a trap, and for a snare, to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

verses.text: And, against which, many shall stumble, And shall fall, and be broken; and shall be ensnared, and caught.
Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.
And I will wait for Jehovah, who hideth his face From the house of Jacob; and I will look for him.
verses.html:
And I will wait for Jehovah, who hideth his face
From the house of Jacob; and I will look for him.

verses.text: Behold, I and the children whom Jehovah hath given me Are for signs and for wonders in Israel; From Jehovah of hosts, Who dwelleth upon mount Zion.
verses.html:
Behold, I and the children whom Jehovah hath given me
Are for signs and for wonders in Israel;
From Jehovah of hosts,
Who dwelleth upon mount Zion.

verses.text: And when they shall say unto you: Inquire of the necromancers and the wizards, Who chirp, and mutter: Say ye, Should not a people inquire of their God? Should they inquire of the dead concerning the living?
verses.html:
And when they shall say unto you: Inquire of the necromancers and the wizards, Who chirp, and mutter:
Say ye, Should not a people inquire of their God?
Should they inquire of the dead concerning the living?

verses.text: To the law and to the testimony: If they will not speak according to this word, It is because there is no dawn of day for them.
And they shall pass through the land sorely beset and hungry: And it shall come to pass when they shall hunger and fret themselves, They will curse their king, and their God,
Whether they shall cast their eyes upward, Or shall look unto the earth; for, behold trouble and obscurity, palpable darkness; And a thick night whereinto they shall be driven.

verses.heading: IX / IX
verses.text: But yet there shall not always be darkness to that land wherein is now distress: As in the former time be made no account of The land of Zabulon and the land of Naphtali; So in the latter time he hath exalted The way of the sea beyond Jordan, the Galilee of the nations.
verses.html:
But yet there shall not always be darkness to that land wherein is now distress:
As in the former time be made no account of
The land of Zabulon and the land of Naphtali;
So in the latter time he hath exalted
The way of the sea beyond Jordan, the Galilee of the nations.

verses.text: The people that walked in darkness, Have seen a great light; They that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, Upon them hath the light shined.
Thou hast multiplied the nation, Thou hast increased their joy: They joy before thee as with the joy of harvest; As they rejoice, who divide the spoil.
For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, The rod of his oppressor, hast thou broken, as in the day of Midian.
For every greave of the warrior accoutred for battle, And the garment rolled in blood, Shall be for burning, as fuel for the fire.

For unto us a child is born; unto us a son is given; And the government shall be upon his shoulder: And his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, Mighty God, Father of eternity, Prince of peace.

Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, Upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom; To establish it, and to support it, With judgment and with justice, henceforth and for ever: The zeal of Jehovah of hosts will do this.
verses.html:
Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, Upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom; To establish it, and to support it, With judgment and with justice, henceforth and for ever:
The zeal of Jehovah of hosts will do this.

verses.text: The Lord hath sent a word unto Jacob; And it hath lighted upon Israel:
verses.html:
The Lord hath sent a word unto Jacob;
And it hath lighted upon Israel:

verses.text: And all the people shall know, Even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria; Who in the pride and arrogancy of heart do say:
verses.html:
And all the people shall know,
Even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria;
Who in the pride and arrogancy of heart do say:

verses.text: The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with hewn stone; The sycamores are cut down, but we will substitute cedars.
Therefore shall Jehovah set up the adversaries of Rezin against him, And shall arm his enemies;
verses.html:
Therefore shall Jehovah set up the adversaries of Rezin against him,
And shall arm his enemies;

verses.text: Syria from before, and the Philistines from behind; And they shall devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away; But his hand is still stretched out.
For the people have not turned unto him who smote them; And Jehovah of hosts have they not sought.
verses.html:
For the people have not turned unto him who smote them;
And Jehovah of hosts have they not sought.

verses.text: Therefore shall Jehovah cut off from Israel head and tail; Branch and rush in one day.
verses.html:
Therefore shall Jehovah cut off from Israel head and tail;
Branch and rush in one day.

verses.text: The aged and honourable, they are the head; And the prophet that teacheth falsehood, he is the tail.
For the leaders of this people lead them astray, And they that are led by them shall be devoured.

Wherefore the Lord shall have no joy in their young men, Neither on their orphans, and on their widows, shall he have compassion. For every one of them is ungodly and an evil-doer: And every mouth speaketh folly. For all this his anger is not turned away; But his hand is still stretched out.
For wickedness burneth like a fire; Brier and thorn it shall consume: And it setteth on fire the thickets of the forest, And they shall mount up in volumes of rising smoke.
Through the wrath of Jehovah of hosts is the land darkened; And the people are as the fuel of the fire; No man spareth his brother:
verses.html:
Through the wrath of Jehovah of hosts is the land darkened;
And the people are as the fuel of the fire;
No man spareth his brother:

verses.text: For he snatcheth on the right hand, yet is be hungry; And devoureth on the left, yet is he not satisfied; Each man devoureth the flesh of his own arm:
Manasseh Ephraim, and Ephraim Manasseh; And they both are united together against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away; But his hand is still stretched out.

verses.heading: X / X
verses.text: Wo unto them that decree iniquitous decrees, And to the writers who write grievousness;
To turn aside the needy from judgment, And to rob of their right the poor of my people; That widows may become their prey, And that they may plunder the orphans.
And what will ye do in the day of visitation, And in the desolation which shall come from afar? To whom will ye flee for help? And where will ye leave your glory?
Without me they shall bow down among prisoners, Or among the slain they shall fall. For all this his anger is not turned away; But his hand is still stretched out.
Wo unto the Assyrian, the rod of mine anger, And the staff which is in their hand is mine indignation.
Against an ungodly nation will I send him; And against the people of my wrath will I commission him, To gather spoil, and carry off prey; And to trample them under foot like the mire of the streets.
Howbeit he doth not so purpose, Neither doth his heart so intend; But to destroy is in his heart, And to cut off nations not a few.
For he saith, Are not my princes altogether kings?
Is not Calno as Carchemish? Is not Hamath as Arpad? Is not Samaria as Damascus?
As my hand hath seized the kingdoms of the idols, Whose graven images did excel those of Jerusalem and Samaria;
Shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, So do to Jerusalem and her images?

Wherefore it shall come to pass, that when the Lord hath performed his whole work, Upon mount Zion, and upon Jerusalem: I will punish the fruit of the proud heart of the king of Assyria; And the glory of his high looks.
verses.html:
Wherefore it shall come to pass, that when the Lord hath performed his whole work,
Upon mount Zion, and upon Jerusalem:
I will punish the fruit of the proud heart of the king of Assyria;
And the glory of his high looks.

verses.text: For he saith, By the strength of my hand have I done it, it? And by my wisdom; for I am instructed in wisdom: Yea, I have removed the bounds of people, And I have plundered their hoarded treasures; And I have overthrown those sitting on thrones, like a valiant man.
verses.html:
For he saith, By the strength of my hand have I done it, it? And by my wisdom; for I am instructed in wisdom: Yea, I have removed the bounds of people, And I have plundered their hoarded treasures;
And I have overthrown those sitting on thrones, like a valiant man.

verses.text: And my band hath found, as a nest, the riches of the nations: And as one gathereth eggs that are left, Have I gathered the whole earth; And there was no one that moved the wing; Or that opened the beak, or that chirped.

Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? Shall the saw magnify itself against him that moveth As if the rod should wield them that lift it up; As if die staff should lift up its master.
Therefore shall the Lord, the Lord of hosts, send Upon his fat ones leanness; And under his glory shall he kindle a burning, Like the burning of a fire.
And the light of Israel shall become a fire, And his Holy One a flame; And he shall burn and consume his thorns And his briers in one day.
Even the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, From the soul even unto the flesh, shall he consume; And it shall be as when a sick man fainteth.
And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, So that a child may number them.

And it shall come to pass in that day, That the remnant of Israel, And such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, Shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; But shall stay upon Jehovah, The Holy One of Israel, in truth.
verses.html:
And it shall come to pass in that day,
That the remnant of Israel,
And such as are escaped of the house of Jacob,
Shall no more again stay upon him that smote them;
But shall stay upon Jehovah,
The Holy One of Israel, in truth.

verses.text: Yet a remnant shall return, a remnant of Jacob, Unto the mighty God.
For though thy people, O Israel, be as the sand of the sea, A remnant of them only shall return. Destruction hath been decreed, Overflowing with justice.
For a havock, even the judgment decreed, Shall the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, make In the midst of the whole land.
verses.html:
For a havock, even the judgment decreed,
Shall the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, make
In the midst of the whole land.

verses.text: But yet thus saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts: Fear not, O my people that dwellest in Zion, because of the Assyrian: With his rod he shall smite thee, And his staff he shall lift up against thee, after the manner of Egypt
verses.html:
But yet thus saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts:
Fear not, O my people that dwellest in Zion, because of the Assyrian:
With his rod he shall smite thee,
And his staff he shall lift up against thee, after the manner of Egypt

verses.text: For yet a very little while, and indignation shall cease; And mine anger be turned towards their destruction.
verses.html:
For yet a very little while, and indignation shall cease;
And mine anger be turned towards their destruction.

verses.text: And Jehovah of hosts, shall stir up a scourge for him, Like the smiting of Midian at the rock Oreb, And like his rod over the sea, When he lifted it up against the Egyptians.
verses.html:
And Jehovah of hosts, shall stir up a scourge for him,
Like the smiting of Midian at the rock Oreb,
And like his rod over the sea,
When he lifted it up against the Egyptians.

verses.text: Then it shall come to pass, in that day, That his burden shall be removed from off thy shoulder, And his yoke from off thy neck: And the yoke shall be destroyed because of fatness.
verses.html:
Then it shall come to pass, in that day,
That his burden shall be removed from off thy shoulder,
And his yoke from off thy neck:
And the yoke shall be destroyed because of fatness.

verses.text: He is come to Aiath; he hath passed through Migron; At Michmas he hath laid up his baggage.
They are gone over the passage; at Geba they have taken up their lodging: Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul hath fled.
Lift up thy voice, O daughter of Gallim! Listen in the direction of Laish, O afflicted Anathoth!
Madmena is gone away; the inhabitants of Gebim have fled.
He will, as yet, remain a day at Nob; After that he shall shake his hand against the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
Behold the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, Shall lop the bough with a dreadful crash; And the high of stature shall be cut down, And the lofty shall be brought low.
verses.html:
Behold the Lord, Jehovah of hosts,
Shall lop the bough with a dreadful crash;
And the high of stature shall be cut down,
And the lofty shall be brought low.

verses.text: And he shall hew the thickets of the forest with iron, And Lebanon shall fall by a mighty hand.
verses.html:
And he shall hew the thickets of the forest with iron,
And Lebanon shall fall by a mighty hand.

verses.heading: XI / XI
verses.text: And there shall come forth a rod from the stem, of Jesse; And a shoot from his root shall produce fruit.
And the spirit of Jehovah shall rest upon him; The spirit of wisdom, and understanding; The spirit of counsel, and might; The spirit of knowledge, and the fear of Jehovah.
verses.html:
And the spirit of Jehovah shall rest upon him;
The spirit of wisdom, and understanding;
The spirit of counsel, and might;
The spirit of knowledge, and the fear of Jehovah.

verses.text: And his delight shall be in the fear of Jehovah: So that he shall not judge according to the sight of his eyes, Neither give sentence according to the hearing of his ears;
verses.html:
And his delight shall be in the fear of Jehovah:
So that he shall not judge according to the sight of his eyes,
Neither give sentence according to the hearing of his ears;

verses.text: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, And with equity shall he give sentence to the meek of the earth. And he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, And with the breath of his lips he shall slay the wicked.
And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, And faithfulness the girdle of his reins.

Then shall the wolf take up his abode with the lamb; And the leopard shall lie down with the kid: And the calf, and the young lion, and the fading shall be together; And a little child shall lead them.
And the cow and the bear shall feed together; Their young ones shall lie down together: And the lion shall eat straw like the ox.
And the sucking child shall play at the hole of the asp, And upon the den of the basilisk shall the newly weaned child lay his hand.
They shall not hurt, nor destroy, in all my holy mountain; For the earth shall be full of the knowledge of Jehovah, As the waters cover the sea.
verses.html:
They shall not hurt, nor destroy, in all my holy mountain;
For the earth shall be full of the knowledge of Jehovah,
As the waters cover the sea.

verses.text: And in that day there shall be A root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign to the people; Unto him shall the nations repair, And his place of rest shall be glorious.

And it shall come to pass in that day, That the Lord shall again the second time put forth his hand, To recover the remnant of his people That remaineth, from Assyria, and from Egypt; And from Pathros, and from Ethiopia, and from Elam; And from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the Islands of the sea.
And he shall lift up an ensign to the nations; And he shall gather the outcasts of Israel, And the dispersed of Judah shall he collect, From the four extremities of the earth.
And the jealousy of Ephraim shall depart, And the adversaries in Judah shall be cut off; Ephraim shall not be jealous of Judah, Neither shall Judah be at enmity with Ephraim.

But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; Together shall they spoil the children of the east; On Edom and Moab they shall lay their hand; And the sons of Ammon shall obey them.

And Jehovah shall devote to destruction the tongue of the sea of Egypt; And he shall shake his hand over the river with his vehement wind, And he shall strike it into seven streams, So that one may pass over it dry-shod.
verses.html:
And Jehovah shall devote to destruction the tongue of the sea of Egypt;
And he shall shake his hand over the river with his vehement wind,
And he shall strike it into seven streams,
So that one may pass over it dry-shod.

verses.text: And there shall be a high-way for the remnant of his people, Which shall remain from Assyria, As there was unto Israel In the day when he came up from the land of Egypt.

verses.heading: Xll. / Xll.
verses.text: And in that day thou shalt say: I will praise thee, O Jehovah; for though thou hast been angry with me, Thine anger is turned away, and thou hast comforted me.
verses.html:
And in that day thou shalt say:
I will praise thee, O Jehovah; for though thou hast been angry with me,
Thine anger is turned away, and thou hast comforted me.

verses.text: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and will not be afraid: For my strength and my song is the Lord Jehovah; And he is become my salvation.
verses.html:
Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and will not be afraid:
For my strength and my song is the Lord Jehovah; And he is become my salvation.

verses.text: And ye shall draw waters with joy From the fountains of salvation.
And ye shall say in that day: Praise Jehovah; call upon his name; Make known among the people his mighty deeds, Make mention that his name is exalted.
verses.html:
And ye shall say in that day:
Praise Jehovah; call upon his name;
Make known among the people his mighty deeds, Make mention that his name is exalted.

verses.text: Sing ye unto Jehovah; for he hath wrought a stupendous work: This is known in all the earth.
verses.html:
Sing ye unto Jehovah; for he hath wrought a
stupendous work:
This is known in all the earth.

verses.text: Cry aloud, and shout for joy, O inhabitress of Zion! For great in the midst of thee is the Holy One of Israel.

verses.heading: XIII / XIII
verses.text: the ORACLE CONCERNING BABYLON, WHICH WAS REVEALED UNTO ISAIAH, THE SON OF AMOZ.
Upon a lofty mountain erect the standard; Exalt the voice unto them; beckon with the hand; That they may enter the gates of princes.
To my appointed ones I have given command; I have also called my strong ones to execute my wrath; My proudly exulting ones.
Hark! a sound of a multitude in the mountains, as of a great people; A sound of the tumult of kingdoms, of nations gathered together! Jehovah of hosts mustereth the armies for the battle.
verses.html:
Hark! a sound of a multitude in the mountains, as of a great people; A sound of the tumult of kingdoms, of nations gathered together!
Jehovah of hosts mustereth the armies for the battle.

verses.text: They come from a far country, from the end of the heavens; Jehovah, and the instruments of his wrath, to destroy the whole land.
verses.html:
They come from a far country, from the end of the heavens;
Jehovah, and the instruments of his wrath, to destroy the whole land.

verses.text: Howl ye, for the day of Jehovah is at hand: As a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
verses.html:
Howl ye, for the day of Jehovah is at hand:
As a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.

verses.text: Therefore shall all hands be slackened, And every heart of mortal shall melt;

And they shall be terrified: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; As a woman in travail shall they be in pain: They shall look one upon another with astonishment; Faces of flames shall be their faces.
Behold the day of Jehovah cometh, cruel, And full of fury and burning anger, To make the earth a desolation: And her sinners he shall destroy from out of her.
verses.html:
Behold the day of Jehovah cometh, cruel,
And full of fury and burning anger,
To make the earth a desolation:
And her sinners he shall destroy from out of her.

verses.text: For the stars of heaven, and the constellations thereof, Shall not send forth their light: The sun is darkened in his going forth, And the moon shall not cause her light to shine.
And I will punish the world for its evil, And the wicked for their iniquity: And I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease; And I will lay low the haughtiness of tyrants.
I will moke a mortal more precious than fine gold; Yea a man, than the golden wedge of Ophir.
Wherefore I will make the heavens tremble, And the earth shall be shaken out of her place, During the indignation of Jehovah of hosts; And in the day of his burning anger.
verses.html:
Wherefore I will make the heavens tremble, And the earth shall be shaken out of her place,
During the indignation of Jehovah of hosts;
And in the day of his burning anger.

verses.text: Then shall every one be, as a roe that is chased, And as a flock of sheep, when there is no one to gather them together, They shall look, each man towards his own people; And they shall flee, every one into his own land.
Every one that is overtaken, shall be thrust through; And all that are rallied together shall fall by the sword.
Their children also shall be dashed in pieces before their eyes; Their houses shall be plundered, and their wives ravished.
Behold, I stir up the Medes against them, Who shall hold silver of no account; And as for gold, they shall not delight in it.
Their bows shall dash the young men to pieces, And they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb: Their eye shall not spare the children.
And Babylon, the beauty of kingdoms, The glory of the pride of the Chaldeans, Shall be as Sodom and Gomorrah, which God overthrew.

It shall not be inhabited for ever, Neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: Neither shall the Arabian pitch his tent there; Neither shall the shepherds make their flocks to rest there.

But there shall the wild beasts of the deserts couch them down; And yelling creatures shall fill their houses; And there shall the daughters of the ostrich dwell; And there shall the satyrs lead their dances.
And wolves shall howl to one another in their palaces; And jackals in their temples of pleasure. And her time is near to come; And her days shall not be prolonged.

verses.heading: XIV / XIV
verses.text: For Jehovah will have compassion on Jacob, And will yet choose Israel; And he will settle them in their own land, And the stranger shall be joined unto them; And they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.
verses.html:
For Jehovah will have compassion on Jacob,
And will yet choose Israel;
And he will settle them in their own land,
And the stranger shall be joined unto them;
And they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.

verses.text: And the people shall take them, and bring them into their own place; And the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of Jehovah, As servants, and as handmaids: And they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; And they shall rule over their oppressors.
verses.html:
And the people shall take them, and bring them into their own place;
And the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of Jehovah,
As servants, and as handmaids:
And they shall take them captives, whose captives they were;
And they shall rule over their oppressors.

verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, when Jehovah shall give thee rest from thine affliction, and from thy disquiet, and from the hard labour which was imposed upon thee,
verses.html: And it shall come to pass in that day, when Jehovah shall give thee rest from thine affliction, and from thy disquiet, and from the hard labour which was imposed upon thee,

verses.text: that thou shalt take up this parable against the king of Babylon; and shalt say: How hath the oppressor ceased! She that exacted gold ceased!
Jehovah hath broken the staff of the wicked, The rod of the tyrants,
verses.html:
Jehovah hath broken the staff of the wicked,
The rod of the tyrants,

verses.text: Which smote the people in wrath, With a smiting without intermission; That ruled the nations in anger, With an oppression without restraint
The whole earth is at rest, it is quiet; They have burst forth into a joyful shout:
Even the fir-trees rejoice over thee, And the cedars of Lebanon, saying: Since thou art laid down, No feller hath come up against us.

Hades from beneath is moved because of thee, To meet thee at thy coming: It stirreth up for thee the shades of all the chieftains of the earth; It maketh to rise from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
verses.html:
Hades from beneath is moved because of thee,
To meet thee at thy coming:
It stirreth up for thee the shades of all the chieftains of the earth;
It maketh to rise from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

verses.text: All these shall speak, and say unto thee: Art thou also become weak as we? Art thou become like unto us?
Thy pomp is brought down to Hades, The sounding of thy viols: Under thee is spread the worm, And the maggot is thy covering.
How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! Cut down to the earth, Thou that didst triumph over the nations!
For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend the heavens; Above the stars of God will I exalt my throne; And I will sit upon the mount of the assembly, in the farthest regions of the North:
I will ascend above the heights of the cloud; I will be like the Most High.
Yet thou shalt be brought down to Hades, To the lowest depths of the pit.
Those that see thee shall look attentively at thee; They shall meditate upon thee; Is this the man that made the earth to tremble? That shook the kingdoms?
That made the world like a wilderness, And destroyed the cities thereof? That loosed not his prisoners homeward?
All the kings of the nations, all of them, Lie down in splendour, each in his own sepulchre:

But thou art cast away, deprived of thy grave, As a branch that is abominated; Covered with the slain, the pierced by the sword, Who soon go down to the stones of the pit, As a carcase trodden under foot.
verses.html:
But thou art cast away, deprived of thy grave, As a branch that is abominated; Covered with the slain, the pierced by the sword,
Who soon go down to the stones of the pit,
As a carcase trodden under foot.

verses.text: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial; Because thou hast destroyed thy country, hast slain thy people: The seed of evil doers shall not be named for ever.
Prepare slaughter for his children, For the iniquity of their fathers; Lest they rise, and possess the earth,. And fill the face of the world with enemies.
For I will rise up against them, saith Jehovah of hosts, I will cut off from Babylon name and remnant; And son and grandson, saith Jehovah.
verses.html:
For I will rise up against them, saith Jehovah of hosts,
I will cut off from Babylon name and remnant;
And son and grandson, saith Jehovah.

verses.text: And I will make it a place of inheritance for the porcupine, and pools of water; And I will sweep it away with the besom of destruction, saith Jehovah of hosts.
verses.html:
And I will make it a place of inheritance for the porcupine, and pools of water;
And I will sweep it away with the besom of destruction, saith Jehovah of hosts.

verses.text: Jehovah of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have devised, so shall it be; And as I have purposed, so it shall stand:
verses.html:
Jehovah of hosts hath sworn, saying,
Surely as I have devised, so shall it be;
And as I have purposed, so it shall stand:

verses.text: To crush the Assyrian in my land, And upon my mountains will I trample him: Then shall his yoke depart from off them, And his burden shall be removed from off their shoulder.
This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth; And this is the band which is stretched out over all the nations.
For Jehovah of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it? And as to his hand that is stretched out, who shall turn it back?
verses.html:
For Jehovah of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it?
And as to his hand that is stretched out, who shall turn it back?

verses.text: IN THE YEAR IN WHICH AHAZ THE KING DIED, THIS ORACLE WAS DELIVERED.
Rejoice not, O Philistia, through thy extent, Because the rod which smote thee is broken: For from the root of the serpent shall come forth a basilisk; And his fruit shall be a flying serpent.
And the first-born of the poor shall feed, And the needy shall lie down in safety: But I will kill thy root with famine, And thy remnant shall he slay.
Howl, O gate! cry out, O city! O Philistia, thou art altogether agitated! For from the North cometh a smoke; And no one standeth aloof from among his troop.
And what shall one answer the ambassadors of the nations? That Jehovah hath founded Zion; And the poor of his people shall take refuge in her.
verses.html:
And what shall one answer the ambassadors of the nations?
That Jehovah hath founded Zion;
And the poor of his people shall take refuge in her.

verses.heading: XV / XV
verses.text: THE ORACLE CONCERNING MOAB. Surely in a destructive night shall Ar of Moab be cut off; Surely in a destructive night shall Kir of Moab be cut off.
He goeth up to Bajith and to Debon, the high places, to weep: Over Nebo, and over Medeba, shall Moab howl: On every head there is baldness; every beard is shorn.
In their streets they gird themselves with sackcloth; On their house-tops, and in their main-streets, Every one shrieketh, melting into tears.
And Heshbon crieth out, and Elealeh; Unto Jahaz is their voice heard: Therefore do the warriors of Moab wail; Their soul shuddereth within them.

My heart crieth out for Moab, Her fugitives wander even unto Zoar, Unto Eglath-Schalischiia; Yea the ascent of Luhith with weeping shall they ascend; Yea in the way of Horonaim shall they raise a cry of destruction.
verses.html:
My heart crieth out for Moab,
Her fugitives wander even unto Zoar,
Unto Eglath-Schalischiia;
Yea the ascent of Luhith with weeping shall they ascend;
Yea in the way of Horonaim shall they raise a cry of destruction.

verses.text: For the waters of Nimrim shall become desolate: For the pasture is withered, the tender plant faileth, the green herb is no more.
Therefore the remnant which they possess, And that which they have laid up; Shall they carry off to the valley of willows.
For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; Unto Eglaim her lamentation; And to Beer-Elim her lamentation.
Yea the waters of Dimon are full of blood: Yet will I bring more evils upon Dimon; Upon them of Moab that shall have escaped a lion, And upon the remnant of the land.

verses.heading: XVI / XVI
verses.text: Send forth the lambs of the ruler of the land, From Selah of the desert, Unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.
For it shall be, that as a wandering bird, a nest forsaken, So shall the daughters of Moab be at the fords of Arnon.
Impart counsel; execute justice; Make thy shadow like unto the night, in the midst of the noon-day: Hide the out-casts; betray not the fugitives.

Let my out-casts, the Moabites, dwell with thee; Be thou to them a covert from the destroyer: For the oppressor is no more, the destroyer ceaseth; He that trampled you under foot is perished from the land.
And the throne shall be established in mercy, And thereon shall be seated in truth, In the tabernacle of David, a judge; And he will carefully search out the right, And promptly execute justice.
We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: His haughtiness, and his pride, and his anger: His vain boastings.
Therefore shall Moab lament over Moab, Every one shall lament; For the fortifications of Kir-haraseth shall ye moan, Ye the deeply afflicted.

For the fields of Heshbon languish, The vine of Sibmah, the lords of the nations have broken down the fruitful tendrils thereof; Unto Jazer did they reach, they wandered over the desert: Her branches extended themselves, they passed over the sea.

Therefore I will weep, with the weeping of Jazer, for the vine of Sibmah; I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon and Elealeh! For upon thy summer fruits, and upon thy harvest, the war-shout is fallen.

And joy and gladness is taken away from the fruitful field; And in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither any shouting: Wine into the vats the treader shall no longer tread; The shout of joy I have made to cease.
Wherefore my bowels shall sound like a harp for Moab; And mine inward parts for Kirharesh.
And it shall be, when it is seen That Moab hath wearied himself out on the high place, Then shall he enter into his sanctuary to pray; But he shall not prevail.
This is the word, which Jehovah spake concerning Moab long ago;
verses.html: This is the word, which Jehovah spake concerning Moab long ago;

verses.text: but now Jehovah hath spoken, saying: After three years, as the years of an hireling, The glory of Moab shall be debased, Together with all his great multitude; And the remnant shall be very few, not many.
verses.html:
but now Jehovah hath spoken, saying:
After three years, as the years of an hireling,
The glory of Moab shall be debased,
Together with all his great multitude;
And the remnant shall be very few, not many.

verses.heading: XVII / XVII
verses.text: THE ORACLE CONCERNING DAMASCUS. Behold, Damascus is removed from being a city; And it shall become a ruinous heap.
The cities of Aroer are forsaken: They shall be for flocks, And they shall lie down, and none shall scare them away.
The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, And the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: They shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, Saith Jehovah of hosts.
verses.html:
The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, And the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: They shall be as the glory of the children of Israel,
Saith Jehovah of hosts.

verses.text: And in that day it shall come to pass, That the glory of Jacob shall be diminished, And the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.
verses.html:
And in that day it shall come to pass,
That the glory of Jacob shall be diminished,
And the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.

verses.text: And it shall be as when a reaper gathereth the standing corn, And his arm reapeth the ears of corn; Or as when one gleaneth the ears in the valley of Rephaim.

A gleaning only shall be left in it, as in the shaking of an olive tree, Two or three berries on the top of the uppermost bough; Four or five on the fruitful branches thereof: Saith Jehovah the God of Israel.
verses.html:
A gleaning only shall be left in it, as in the shaking of an olive tree, Two or three berries on the top of the uppermost bough; Four or five on the fruitful branches thereof:
Saith Jehovah the God of Israel.

verses.text: In that day shall a man regard his Maker, And toward the Holy One of Israel shall his eyes look:
And he shall not regard the altars, the work of his hands; And what his fingers have made he shall not respect; Neither the idols, nor the images.

In that day shall his strongly fenced cities become Like the abandoned remains of a forest, and the topmost branches, Which they left from before the children of Israel; And there shall be utter desolation.
Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, And hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength; Therefore thou shaft plant pleasant plants, And engraft them with foreign shoots.
In the day shalt thou make thy plants to grow, And in the morning shalt thou make thy seed to flourish; But the harvest, in the day of possession, flieth away; And painful is the disaster.
Ah! the noise of many people; They make a noise like the noise of the seas: And ah! the rushing of nations; They make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters.
verses.html:
Ah! the noise of many people; They make a noise like the noise of the seas:
And ah! the rushing of nations;
They make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters.

verses.text: Ah! the rushing of nations; like the rushing of mighty waters do they rush: But He shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far away; And they shall be driven, like the chaff of the mountains before the wind, And like the rolling dust before the whirlwind,
verses.html:
Ah! the rushing of nations; like the rushing of mighty waters do they rush:
But He shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far away;
And they shall be driven, like the chaff of the mountains before the wind,
And like the rolling dust before the whirlwind,

verses.text: At eveningtide, behold terror! Before the morning he is no more! This is the portion of those who spoil us; And the lot of those who plunder us.

verses.heading: XVIII / XVIII
verses.text: Ho! Thou land that makest a loud noise with thy wings, Which is beyond the rivers of Cush;
verses.html:
Ho! Thou land that makest a loud noise with thy wings,
Which is beyond the rivers of Cush;

verses.text: Which sendeth ambassadors along the sea, And in vessels of papyrus on the face of the waters: Go, ye swift messengers, To a nation strong and formidable, To a people terrible; and, from beyond them, To a nation very strong and overpowering, Whose lands the rivers tear up; and say:
verses.html:
Which sendeth ambassadors along the sea, And in vessels of papyrus on the face of the waters: Go, ye swift messengers, To a nation strong and formidable, To a people terrible; and, from beyond them, To a nation very strong and overpowering,
Whose lands the rivers tear up; and say:

verses.text: All ye inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, When the standard is lifted up on the mountains, see ye; And when the trumpet is sounded, hear!
For thus hath Jehovah said unto me: I will take my rest, and I will look on in my dwelling-place, Like a clear heat in the sun-shine, Like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.
verses.html:
For thus hath Jehovah said unto me:
I will take my rest, and I will look on in my dwelling-place,
Like a clear heat in the sun-shine,
Like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.

verses.text: For before the harvest, when the bud is perfect, And the flower is become a ripening grape, He shall cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks; And the branches he shall remove away, he shall cut down.

They shall be left together unto the rapacious bird of the mountains, And to the wild beast of the earth: And the rapacious bird shall summer upon them, And every wild beast of the earth shall winter upon them.

At that time shall a present be brought to Jehovah of hosts, From a people strong and formidable, And from a people terrible; and, from beyond them, From a nation very strong and overpowering, Whose lands the rivers tear up; To the place of the name of Jehovah of hosts, the mount Zion.
verses.html:
At that time shall a present be brought to Jehovah of hosts,
From a people strong and formidable,
And from a people terrible; and, from beyond them,
From a nation very strong and overpowering,
Whose lands the rivers tear up;
To the place of the name of Jehovah of hosts, the mount Zion.

verses.heading: XIX / XIX
verses.text: THE ORACLE CONCERNING EGYPT. Behold, Jehovah rideth Upon a swift cloud, and cometh to Egypt: And the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, And the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of her.
verses.html:
THE ORACLE CONCERNING EGYPT.
Behold, Jehovah rideth
Upon a swift cloud, and cometh to Egypt:
And the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence,
And the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of her.

verses.text: And I will excite the Egyptians against the Egyptians, And they shall fight, every man against his brother, and every man against his neighbour: City against city, kingdom against kingdom.
And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; And I will destroy her counsel: And they shall seek to the idols, and to the sorcerers, And to the necromancers, and to the soothsayers.
And I will deliver up the Egyptians into the hands of a cruel lord, And a fierce king shall rule over them: Saith the Lord Jehovah of hosts.
verses.html:
And I will deliver up the Egyptians into the hands of a cruel lord, And a fierce king shall rule over them:
Saith the Lord Jehovah of hosts.

verses.text: Then shall the waters fail from the sea, And the river shall be wasted and dried up:
And the rivers shall send forth stench, The canals of Egypt shall waste away and become dry, The reed and the rush shall wither:
The meadows by the river, even at the mouth of the river, And every thing sown by the river, Shall be dried up, scattered by the wind, and be no more.
The fishers also shall mourn, And all they that cast angle into the river shall lament; And they that spread nets upon the face of the waters shall languish.
And the workers of combed flax shall be confounded, And they that weave white linen.
And her foundations are broken in pieces, And all workers for hire are afflicted in soul.
Surely, the princes of Zoan are fools: As for the wise counsellors of Pharaoh, Their counsel is become foolish. How will ye say unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, a son of ancient kings?
verses.html:
Surely, the princes of Zoan are fools: As for the wise counsellors of Pharaoh,
Their counsel is become foolish.
How will ye say unto Pharaoh,
I am the son of the wise, a son of ancient kings?

verses.text: Where now are they, thy wise men? And let them tell thee now, if they know, What Jehovah of hosts hath determined against Egypt.
verses.html:
Where now are they, thy wise men? And let them tell thee now, if they know,
What Jehovah of hosts hath determined against Egypt.

verses.text: The princes of Zoan are become foolish, the princes of Noph are deceived; And they, even the heads of her tribes, have caused Egypt to err.
Jehovah hath mingled in the midst of her a spirit of giddiness; And they have caused Egypt to err in all her works, As a drunkard staggereth in his vomit.
verses.html:
Jehovah hath mingled in the midst of her a spirit of giddiness;
And they have caused Egypt to err in all her works,
As a drunkard staggereth in his vomit.

verses.text: Neither shall there be done by Egypt any work, Which the head or tail, the branch or rush, may do.
In that day the Egyptians shall be as women; And they shall tremble and fear, At the shaking of the hand of Jehovah of hosts, Which he shall shake over them.
verses.html:
In that day the Egyptians shall be as women; And they shall tremble and fear,
At the shaking of the hand of Jehovah of hosts,
Which he shall shake over them.

verses.text: And the land of Judah shall become a terror to the Egyptians: Every one to whom a mention is made of it shall fear; Because of the counsel of Jehovah of hosts, Which he hath counselled against them.
verses.html:
And the land of Judah shall become a terror to the Egyptians: Every one to whom a mention is made of it shall fear;
Because of the counsel of Jehovah of hosts,
Which he hath counselled against them.

verses.text: In that day there shall be five cities in the land of Egypt, Speaking the language of Canaan, And swearing by Jehovah of hosts: One of them shall be called, The city of Destruction.
verses.html:
In that day there shall be five cities in the land of Egypt, Speaking the language of Canaan,
And swearing by Jehovah of hosts:
One of them shall be called, The city of Destruction.

verses.text: In that day there shall be an altar to Jehovah In the midst of the land of Egypt; And a pillar at the boundary thereof to Jehovah:
verses.html:
In that day there shall be an altar to Jehovah
In the midst of the land of Egypt;
And a pillar at the boundary thereof to Jehovah:

verses.text: And it shall be for a sign, and for a witness, To Jehovah of hosts in the land of Egypt; For that they cried unto Jehovah because of oppressors, And he sent unto them a saviour, and a defender, and he delivered them.
verses.html:
And it shall be for a sign, and for a witness,
To Jehovah of hosts in the land of Egypt;
For that they cried unto Jehovah because of oppressors,
And he sent unto them a saviour, and a defender, and he delivered them.

verses.text: And Jehovah shall be known to Egypt, And the Egyptians shall know Jehovah in that day; And they shall offer up sacrifice and oblation, Yea they shall vow a vow unto Jehovah, and shall perform it.
verses.html:
And Jehovah shall be known to Egypt,
And the Egyptians shall know Jehovah in that day;
And they shall offer up sacrifice and oblation,
Yea they shall vow a vow unto Jehovah, and shall perform it.

verses.text: And Jehovah shall smite Egypt, smiting and healing her; And they shall turn unto Jehovah, and he will be entreated by them, and will heal them.
verses.html:
And Jehovah shall smite Egypt, smiting and healing her;
And they shall turn unto Jehovah, and he will be entreated by them, and will heal them.

verses.text: In that day there shall be a highway from Egypt towards Assyria; And the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria: And the Egyptian shall worship with the Assyrian.
In that day shall Israel be the third With Egypt and with Assyria, Even a blessing in the midst of the earth:
verses.html:
