verses.html: Go, and say unto Hezekiah, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of David thy father: I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: Behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.

verses.text: And I will deliver thee, and this city, out of the hand of the king of Assyria: and I will defend this city.
And this shall be a sign unto thee from Jehovah, that Jehovah will do this thing which he hath spoken.
verses.html: And this shall be a sign unto thee from Jehovah, that Jehovah will do this thing which he hath spoken.

verses.text: Behold, I will cause the shadow of degrees, which hath gone down, by the sun, on the dial of Ahaz, to go back ten degrees. And the sun returned back ten degrees, by the degrees by which it had gone down.
THE WRITING OF HEZEKIAH KING OF JUDAH, WHEN HE HAD BEEN SICK, AND WAS RECOVERED FROM HIS SICKNESS.
I said: In the noontide of my days I shall go to the gates of the grave; I am deprived of the residue of my years.
I said: I shall no more see Jehovah, Jehovah in the land of the living; I shall not behold man any more, Being numbered among the inhabitants of the land of stillness.
verses.html:
I said: I shall no more see Jehovah,
Jehovah in the land of the living;
I shall not behold man any more,
Being numbered among the inhabitants of the land of stillness.

verses.text: My habitation is taken down, and removed from me, like a shepherd's tent. My life is cut off, as by a weaver; He cutteth me off from the woof; Even from day to night wilt thou make an end of me.
verses.html:
My habitation is taken down, and removed from me, like a shepherd's tent. My life is cut off, as by a weaver; He cutteth me off from the woof;
Even from day to night wilt thou make an end of me.

verses.text: I resembled a roaring lion till the morning, So did He break all my bones; Even from day to night wilt thou make an end of me.
verses.html:
I resembled a roaring lion till the morning, So did He break all my bones;
Even from day to night wilt thou make an end of me.

verses.text: Like a swallow, or a crane, so did I twitter; I moaned like the dove: Mine eyes foil with looking upward; O Jehovah, I am oppressed; be thou surety for me.
verses.html:
Like a swallow, or a crane, so did I twitter;
I moaned like the dove:
Mine eyes foil with looking upward;
O Jehovah, I am oppressed; be thou surety for me.

verses.text: What shall I say? He hath both spoken unto me, and He hath himself performed it: I will walk humbly all my years on account of the bitterness of my soul.
O Lord, by these things do men live; And from all these things cometh the life of my spirit; For thou hast restored my strength, and preserved my life.
Behold, my bitter anguish is changed into health: Thou hast also in love to me rescued my soul from the pit of destruction; Yea, thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.
For the grave cannot praise thee, Death cannot celebrate thee: They that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.
The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I do this day; The father to the children shall make known thy truth.
Jehovah was at hand to save me: Therefore my stringed instruments will we strike, All the days of our life, in the house of Jehovah.
verses.html:
Jehovah was at hand to save me:
Therefore my stringed instruments will we strike,
All the days of our life, in the house of Jehovah.

verses.text: Now, Isaiah had said: Let them take a lump of figs, and lay it for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall
recover. Hezekiah also had said: What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of Jehovah?
verses.html: recover. Hezekiah also had said: What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of Jehovah?

verses.heading: XXXIX / XXXIX
verses.text: At that time Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah; for he had heard that he had been sick, and was recovered.

And Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them his treasure-house, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found among his treasures. There was nothing in his house, or in all his dominion, that Hezekiah did not shew them.

Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him: What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said: They came unto me from a far country, even from Babylon.
Then said he: What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah said: All that is in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures which I have not shewed them.
Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah:

Hear the word of Jehovah of hosts. Behold, the days shall come, when all that is in thine house, and all that thy fathers have treasured up unto this day, shall be carried away to Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith Jehovah.
verses.html: Hear the word of Jehovah of hosts. Behold, the days shall come, when all that is in thine house, and all that thy fathers have treasured up unto this day, shall be carried away to Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith Jehovah.

verses.text: And of thy sons which shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away, and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
And Hezekiah said to Isaiah: Good is the word of Jehovah, which thou hast spoken: He said, moreover, There shall be peace and truth in my days.
verses.html: And Hezekiah said to Isaiah: Good is the word of Jehovah, which thou hast spoken: He said, moreover, There shall be peace and truth in my days.

verses.heading: XL / XL
verses.text: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God:

Speak ye things pleasing to the heart of Jerusalem, and declare unto her, That her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity hath been expiated; That she hath received at the hand of Jehovah Double for all her sins.
verses.html:
Speak ye things pleasing to the heart of Jerusalem, and declare unto her, That her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity hath been expiated;
That she hath received at the hand of Jehovah
Double for all her sins.

verses.text: A voice crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of Jehovah, Make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
verses.html:
A voice crieth in the wilderness,
Prepare ye the way of Jehovah,
Make straight in the desert a highway for our God.

verses.text: Every valley shall be exalted, And every mountain and bill shall be made low, And the crooked shall become Straight; And the rough places a smooth plain:
And the glory of Jehovah shall be revealed, And all flesh shall See together That the mouth of Jehovah hath spoken it.
verses.html:
And the glory of Jehovah shall be revealed,
And all flesh shall See together
That the mouth of Jehovah hath spoken it.

verses.text: A voice saith, Proclaim! And he said, What shall I proclaim? All flesh is grass, And all his goodliness like the flower of the field:
The grass withereth, the flower fadeth, When the spirit of Jehovah bloweth upon it: Surely the people is grass.
verses.html:
The grass withereth, the flower fadeth,
When the spirit of Jehovah bloweth upon it:
Surely the people is grass.

verses.text: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth; But the word of God shall stand for ever.

Get thee up upon a high mountain, O Zion, that bringest good tidings: Lift up thy voice with strength, O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings; Lift it up; be not afraid: Say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God!
Behold, the Lord. Jehovah shall come with might, And his arm shall rule for him: Behold, his reward is with him; And the recompense of his word is before him.
verses.html:
Behold, the Lord. Jehovah shall come with might,
And his arm shall rule for him:
Behold, his reward is with him;
And the recompense of his word is before him.

verses.text: He shall feed his flock, like a shepherd; In his arm shall he gather up the lambs, And in his bosom carry them; The nursing ewes shall he gently lead.

Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, And hath meted out the heavens with a span; And hath comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, And hath weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
Who hath searched out the Spirit of Jehovah, Or being his counsellor hath taught him?
verses.html:
Who hath searched out the Spirit of Jehovah,
Or being his counsellor hath taught him?

verses.text: With whom took he counsel, that he should instruct him; And teach him in the path of judgment; And teach him knowledge, And shew to him the way of understanding?
Behold, the nations are as a drop from the bucket; And as the small dust on a balance shall they be accounted: Behold, the isles are as an atom which flitteth away.
And Lebanon is not sufficient to supply fire, Nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt-offering.
All the nations are before him, as though they were nought; They are accounted by Him as less than nought and vanity.
To whom then will ye liken God? Or what likeness will ye compare unto him?
The workman casteth an image, And the goldsmith overlayeth it with gold; And forgeth for it chains of silver.
verses.html:
The workman casteth an image, And the goldsmith overlayeth it with gold;
And forgeth for it chains of silver.

verses.text: He that is too poor to make a costly oblation chooseth him a piece of wood that will not rot; He seeketh unto him a skilful workman, To erect an image which shall not be moved.
Have ye not known? have ye not heard? Hath it not been told you from the beginning? Have ye not understood it from the foundations of the earth?
He it is who sitteth upon the circle of the earth, And the inhabitants thereof are as locusts: Who stretcheth out the heavens, like a canopy; And spreadeth them out, as a tent to dwell in:
Who reduceth princes to nothing; Who maketh the rulers of the earth as vanity.

Yea, they shall not scarcely be planted; yea, they shall not scarcely be sown; Yea, their trunk shall not scarcely take root in the earth; And yet should He but blow upon them, they wither; And the whirlwind taketh them away as stubble.
To whom then will ye liken me? And to whom shall I be equalled? saith the Holy One.

Lift up your eyes on high, And behold who hath created these things; Who bringeth out their hosts by number, Who calleth them all by name: Through multitude of strength, and might of power, Not one of them is missing.
Why sayest thou, O Jacob, And speakest, O Israel: My way is hidden from Jehovah, And my cause passeth unregarded by my God?
verses.html:
Why sayest thou, O Jacob, And speakest, O Israel:
My way is hidden from Jehovah,
And my cause passeth unregarded by my God?

verses.text: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, That the everlasting God, Jehovah, the Creator of the ends of the earth, Fainteth not, neither is weary? There is no searching out of his understanding.
verses.html:
Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard,
That the everlasting God, Jehovah, the Creator of the ends of the earth,
Fainteth not, neither is weary?
There is no searching out of his understanding.

verses.text: He giveth power to the faint, And to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
Even the youths shall faint and be weary, And the young men shall utterly fall;
But they that wait upon Jehovah shall gather new strength; They shall mount up with wings as eagles; They shall run, and not be weary, They shall walk, and not faint.
verses.html:
But they that wait upon Jehovah shall gather new strength;
They shall mount up with wings as eagles;
They shall run, and not be weary,
They shall walk, and not faint.

verses.heading: XLI / XLI
verses.text: Keep silence before me, O Islands; And let the nations renew their strength: Let them draw near; then let them speak; Let us come near together to judgment.

Who hath stirred up from the east him, Whom justice met at his feet? Who hath given up the nations before him, that he should rule over kings? Hath made as the dust, his sword; As chaff driven by the wind, his bow?
He hath pursued them, he hath passed safely, By a way which no man had ever gone with his feet.
Who hath wrought and done it, Calling the generations from the beginning? I Jehovah, the first; And with the last, I am the same.
verses.html:
Who hath wrought and done it, Calling the generations from the beginning?
I Jehovah, the first;
And with the last, I am the same.

verses.text: The isles saw it, and feared; The ends of the earth were terrified: They drew near, they came together.
They helped every one his neighbour, And everyone said to his brother, Be of good courage.
verses.html:
They helped every one his neighbour,
And everyone said to his brother, Be of good courage.

verses.text: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, And he that smootheth with the hammer him that smiteth on the anvil: Saying of the soldering, It is good; And he fastened it with nails, that it should not be moved.
verses.html:
So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith,
And he that smootheth with the hammer him that smiteth on the anvil:
Saying of the soldering, It is good;
And he fastened it with nails, that it should not be moved.

verses.text: But thou, O Israel, my servant, O Jacob, whom I have chosen, The seed of Abraham my friend;
Thou, whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, And called thee from the extremities thereof; And said unto thee, Thou art my servant; I have chosen thee, and will not reject thee.
Fear not, for I am with thee; Be not dismayed, for I am thy God. I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; Yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
Behold, all they that were enraged against thee shall be ashamed and confounded: They that contended with thee shall become as nothing, and shall utterly perish.
Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, even the men that strove with thee: They shall become as nothing, and as mere nought, even the men that opposed thee in battle.
For I Jehovah thy God, hold thee fast by thy right hand, Saying unto thee, Fear not: I am thy helper.
verses.html:
For I Jehovah thy God, hold thee fast by thy right hand,
Saying unto thee, Fear not: I am thy helper.

verses.text: Fear not, thou worm Jacob; ye mortals of Israel; I will help thee, saith Jehovah; And thy Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.
verses.html:
Fear not, thou worm Jacob; ye mortals of Israel;
I will help thee, saith Jehovah;
And thy Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.

verses.text: Behold, I have made thee a new sharp threshing wain, armed with pointed teeth: Thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small; And shalt make the hills as chaff.
Thou shalt winnow them, and the wind shall carry them away, And the whirlwind shall scatter them: But thou shalt rejoice in Jehovah, And shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.html:
Thou shalt winnow them, and the wind shall carry them away, And the whirlwind shall scatter them:
But thou shalt rejoice in Jehovah,
And shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.

verses.text: The poor and needy who seek for water, and there is none; Whose tongue is parched with thirst: I Jehovah will hear them; I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.
verses.html:
The poor and needy who seek for water, and there is none; Whose tongue is parched with thirst:
I Jehovah will hear them;
I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.

verses.text: I will open rivers in the high places, And fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, And the dry land springs of waters.
I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the acacia, And the myrtle, and the oil-tree; I will set in the desert the fir-tree, The plane-tree, and the box together:
That they might see, and know, And consider, and understand together, That the hand of Jehovah hath done this, And the Holy One of Israel hath created it.
verses.html:
That they might see, and know, And consider, and understand together,
That the hand of Jehovah hath done this,
And the Holy One of Israel hath created it.

verses.text: Bring forward your cause, saith Jehovah: Produce your strong arguments, saith the King of Jacob,
verses.html:
Bring forward your cause, saith Jehovah:
Produce your strong arguments, saith the King of Jacob,

verses.text: Let them approach, and tell us the things that shall happen; The things that shall first happen, what they are, let them tell us; That we may consider them, and know the event of them: Or declare to us things to come hereafter.
Tell us the things that will come to pass in the later times, That we may know if ye be gods: Yea, do good, or do evil, That we may look around us, and behold together.
Lo, ye are worse than nothing; And your work is less than nought: An abomination is he that maketh choice of you.
I have raised up one from the north, and he shall come; From the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name: And he shall trample on princes, as on mortar; And as the potter treadeth down the clay.

Who hath declared this from the beginning, that we should know it? And beforehand, that we should say, It is right? Yea, there was not one that declared it; yea, not one who had spread the report; Yea, there was not one that heard your words.
I am the first who said unto Zion, Behold, behold them I And gave to Jerusalem a messenger of glad tidings.
verses.html:
I am the first who said unto Zion, Behold, behold them I
And gave to Jerusalem a messenger of glad tidings.

verses.text: And I looked, but there was no man; Even among these, but there was no counsellor; And I inquired of them, but there was no one that could return an answer.
Behold, they are all of them vanity; Their works are nought: Mere wind and emptiness are their molten images.

verses.heading: XLII / XLII
verses.text: Behold my servant, whom I will uphold; My chosen, in whom my soul delighteth: I have put my Spirit upon him; He shall publish judgment to the nations.
He shall not cry, nor raise a clamour, Nor cause his voice to be heard in the streets.
A bruised reed shall he not break, And the smoking flax shall he not quench: According unto truth shall he publish judgment.
He shall not despond, neither shall he be faint; Until he hath firmly seated judgment in the earth: And the isles shall earnestly wait for his law.

Thus saith the God, Jehovah, Who hath created the heavens, and stretched them out; Who hath spread abroad the earth, and the produce thereof; Who giveth breath to the people upon it, And spirit to them that tread thereon:
verses.html:
Thus saith the God, Jehovah,
Who hath created the heavens, and stretched them out;
Who hath spread abroad the earth, and the produce thereof;
Who giveth breath to the people upon it,
And spirit to them that tread thereon:

verses.text: I Jehovah have called thee in righteousness, And I will take hold of thy hand, and will preserve thee; And I will give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the nations;
verses.html:
I Jehovah have called thee in righteousness,
And I will take hold of thy hand, and will preserve thee;
And I will give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the nations;

verses.text: To open the blind eyes, To bring the captive out of confinement; And them that sit in darkness, out of the prison house.
verses.html:
To open the blind eyes, To bring the captive out of confinement;
And them that sit in darkness, out of the prison house.

verses.text: I am Jehovah, that is my name; And my glory will I not give to another, Nor my praise to graven images.
verses.html:
I am Jehovah, that is my name;
And my glory will I not give to another,
Nor my praise to graven images.

verses.text: The former predictions, behold! they are come to pass; And new events I now declare: Before they spring forth, I make them known unto you.
Sing unto Jehovah a new song, His praise from the ends of the earth; Ye that go down upon the sea, and the fulness thereof; The isles, and their inhabitants.
verses.html:
Sing unto Jehovah a new song,
His praise from the ends of the earth;
Ye that go down upon the sea, and the fulness thereof;
The isles, and their inhabitants.

verses.text: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice, The villages that Kedar doth inhabit: Let them sing, who inhabit the rocks; Let them shout aloud from the top of the mountains.
Let them ascribe glory to Jehovah, And declare his praise in the islands.
verses.html:
Let them ascribe glory to Jehovah,
And declare his praise in the islands.

verses.text: Jehovah shall march forth like a hero; Like a mighty warrior shall he stir up his zeal: He shall cry aloud; yea, he shall shout amain; He shall prove himself mighty against his enemies.
verses.html:
Jehovah shall march forth like a hero;
Like a mighty warrior shall he stir up his zeal:
He shall cry aloud; yea, he shall shout amain;
He shall prove himself mighty against his enemies.

verses.text: I have long time holden my peace, I have been still and refrained myself; But now will I cry out like a woman in travail; I will stifle my breath and pour it forth at once.
verses.html:
I have long time holden my peace, I have been still and refrained myself;
But now will I cry out like a woman in travail;
I will stifle my breath and pour it forth at once.

verses.text: I will make waste mountains and hills, And all their herbage will I dry up; And I will change rivers into islands, And the pools will I dry up.

And I will lead the blind by a way that they knew not; Through paths that they have not known will I conduct them: I will turn darkness into light before them; And rugged places into smooth ground. These things will I do for them, and will not forsake them.
They are turned backward, they are utterly confounded, Who trust in graven images, Who say to the molten images, Ye are our gods.
Hear, ye deaf! And, ye blind! look attentively, that ye may see.
Who is blind, if not my servant? Or deaf as my messenger whom I sent? Who is blind like him that is perfect, And blind like the servant of Jehovah?
verses.html:
Who is blind, if not my servant? Or deaf as my messenger whom I sent? Who is blind like him that is perfect,
And blind like the servant of Jehovah?

verses.text: Thou hast seen many things, but thou observest not; Having the ears open, but did not hear.
Jehovah is well pleased for his righteousness’ sake; He shall magnify the law, and render it glorious.
verses.html:
Jehovah is well pleased for his righteousness’ sake;
He shall magnify the law, and render it glorious.

verses.text: But this is a people spoiled and plundered; All their chosen youths are taken in the toils, And in prison houses are they hid: They are become a spoil, and none delivereth; A plunder, and no one saith, Restore.
Who is there among you that will give ear to this? That will attend, and hearken, for the future?
Who hath given Jacob for a spoil, And Israel to the plunderers? Was it not Jehovah? He against whom we have sinned? For they would not walk in his ways, Neither were they obedient unto his law.
verses.html:
Who hath given Jacob for a spoil, And Israel to the plunderers?
Was it not Jehovah? He against whom we have sinned?
For they would not walk in his ways,
Neither were they obedient unto his law.

verses.text: Therefore he hath poured upon them the heat of his anger, and the vehemence of war: And it kindled a flame round about him, yet he regarded it not; And it set him on fire, yet he laid it not to heart.

verses.heading: XLIII / XLIII
verses.text: But now, thus saith Jehovah that created thee, O Jacob, And He that formed thee, O Israel: Fear not, for I have redeemed thee; I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
verses.html:
But now, thus saith Jehovah that created thee, O Jacob,
And He that formed thee, O Israel:
Fear not, for I have redeemed thee;
I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.

verses.text: When thou passest through the waters, I am with thee; And through the rivers, they shall not overwhelm thee; When thou walkest in the fire, thou shalt not be burned; Neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
For I am Jehovah, thy God; The Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I have given Egypt for thy ransom; Cush and Seba in thy stead.
verses.html:
For I am Jehovah, thy God;
The Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour:
I have given Egypt for thy ransom;
Cush and Seba in thy stead.

verses.text: From the time that thou hast been precious in my sight, Thou hast been honoured, and I have loved thee: Therefore will I give men for thee, And nations for thy life.
Fear not, for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, And gather thee from the west.
I will say to the north, Give up; And to the south, Withhold not: Bring my sons from afar, And my daughters from the ends of the earth:
Even every one that is called by my name, For I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.
verses.html:
Even every one that is called by my name,
For I have created him for my glory,
I have formed him; yea, I have made him.

verses.text: Bring forth the people that are blind, although they have eyes; And that are deaf, although they have ears.

Let all the nations be gathered together, And let the people be assembled: Who among them can declare this, And make known unto us former predictions? Let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: Or let them hear, and say, This is true.
Ye are my witnesses, saith Jehovah, And my servant whom I have chosen; That ye may know, and believe me, And understand that I am He: Before me there was no God formed, And after me none shall exist.
verses.html:
Ye are my witnesses, saith Jehovah,
And my servant whom I have chosen;
That ye may know, and believe me,
And understand that I am He:
Before me there was no God formed,
And after me none shall exist.

verses.text: I, even I, am Jehovah; And beside roe there is no Saviour.
verses.html:
I, even I, am Jehovah;
And beside roe there is no Saviour.

verses.text: I have declared my purpose, and I have saved; And have made it known; nor was it any strange god among you: And ye are my witnesses, saith Jehovah, that I am God.
verses.html:
I have declared my purpose, and I have saved;
And have made it known; nor was it any strange god among you:
And ye are my witnesses, saith Jehovah, that I am God.

verses.text: Ever since time began I am He; And there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall undo it?

Thus saith Jehovah, Your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: For your sake have I sent unto Babylon, And made all the fugitives to go down, And the Chaldeans, into the ships of their once joyous clamour.
verses.html:
Thus saith Jehovah,
Your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel:
For your sake have I sent unto Babylon,
And made all the fugitives to go down,
And the Chaldeans, into the ships of their once joyous clamour.

verses.text: I am Jehovah, your Holy One; The Creator of Israel, your King.
verses.html:
I am Jehovah, your Holy One;
The Creator of Israel, your King.

verses.text: Thus saith Jehovah, Who made a way in the sea, And a path in the mighty waters;
verses.html:
Thus saith Jehovah,
Who made a way in the sea,
And a path in the mighty waters;

verses.text: Who hath brought forth the chariot and the horse, the army and the warrior; They lay down together, they rose no more; They were extinguished, they were quenched like tow.
Remember not the former things, Neither regard the things of ancient times.
Behold, I make a new thing; Now shall it spring forth: shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, And rivers in the desert.
verses.html:
Behold, I make a new thing; Now shall it spring forth: shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness,
And rivers in the desert.

verses.text: The wild beast of the field shall honour me, The jackals, and the daughters of the ostrich: Because I give waters in the wilderness, And rivers in the desert, To give drink to my people, my chosen.
This people whom I have formed for myself; They shall recount my praise.
But thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob! Yea, thou hast been weary of me, O Israel!

Thou hast not brought me the lamb of thy burnt-offering, Neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices: I have not burdened thee with exacting oblations, Nor wearied thee with demands of frankincense:

Thou hast not bought for me with silver the sweet cane; Neither hast thou satiated me with the fat of thy sacrifices: But thou hast burdened me with thy sins, Thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.
I, even I, am He, That blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, And will not remember thy sins,
verses.html:
I, even I, am He,
That blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake,
And will not remember thy sins,

verses.text: Put me in remembrance; let us plead together: Set forth thy cause, that thou mayest be justified.
Thy first father hath sinned, And thy interpreters have transgressed against me;
Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary; And have given Jacob to the curse, And Israel to reproaches.

verses.heading: XLIV / XLIV
verses.text: Yet now hear, O Jacob, my servant! And Israel! whom I have chosen:
Thus saith Jehovah who made thee, And formed thee from the womb, He will help thee; Fear not, my servant Jacob, And thou Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.
verses.html:
Thus saith Jehovah who made thee,
And formed thee from the womb, He will help thee;
Fear not, my servant Jacob,
And thou Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.

verses.text: For I will pour waters upon the thirsty soil, And flowing streams upon the dry ground; I will pour my Spirit upon thy seed, And my blessing upon thine offspring.
And they shall spring up as among the grass, As willows by the water-courses.
One shall say: I am Jehovah’s; And another shall call himself by the name of Jacob: And another shall inscribe upon his hand, I am Jehovah’s; And shall be surnamed by the name of Israel.
verses.html:
One shall say: I am Jehovah’s;
And another shall call himself by the name of Jacob:
And another shall inscribe upon his hand, I am Jehovah’s;
And shall be surnamed by the name of Israel.

verses.text: Thus saith Jehovah, the King of Israel, And his Redeemer, Jehovah of hosts: I am the first, and I am the last; And beside me there is no God.
verses.html:
Thus saith Jehovah, the King of Israel,
And his Redeemer, Jehovah of hosts:
I am the first, and I am the last;
And beside me there is no God.

verses.text: And who like me could foretell, And declare it; or who could dispose it for me, From the time that I have appointed the ancient people; So that the things which are now coming, and what shall come hereafter, should become known unto them?
Fear ye not, neither be afraid: Have I not of old made it known unto thee, and declared it? And ye are my witnesses. Is there a God beside me? Yea, there is no Rock; I know not any.
They that form a graven image are all of them vanity; And their objects of delight shall not profit: Yea, they are their witnesses, that they see not, Nor understand; so that they may be ashamed.
Who hath formed a god, or molten a graven image, That is profitable for nothing?
Behold, all his associates shall be ashamed; And the workmen themselves who are of men: Let them assemble, all of them; let them stand up; They shall fear, and be ashamed together.

The smith maketh an axe, And worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers; And worketh it with the strength of his arm: Yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth him; He drinketh no water, and is faint.
verses.html:
The smith maketh an axe,
And worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers;
And worketh it with the strength of his arm:
Yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth him;
He drinketh no water, and is faint.

verses.text: The carpenter stretcheth out the line; He marketh out the form of it with red ochre: He worketh it with planes, And with the compass he marketh it out: He maketh it after the figure of a man, According to the beauty of the human form, that it may abide in the house.
He heweth him down cedars, He taketh also the pine, and the oak; And he chooseth for himself among the trees of the forest: He planteth the ash, and the rain nourisheth it.

Then shall it be for man to burn; And he taketh thereof, and warmeth himself; Yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread; Yea, he formeth a god, and worshippeth it; He maketh of it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.
verses.html:
Then shall it be for man to burn; And he taketh thereof, and warmeth himself;
Yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread;
Yea, he formeth a god, and worshippeth it;
He maketh of it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.

verses.text: Part of it he burneth in the fire; On a part of it he eateth flesh: He roasteth meat, and is satisfied; Yea, he warmeth himself, and saith: Aha! I am warm, I have seen the fire.
And the residue thereof he maketh a god, even his graven image: He falleth down unto it, and worshippeth it; And he prayeth unto it, and saith: Deliver me, for thou art my God!
They know not, neither do they understand; For he hath closed up their eyes, that they cannot see; And their hearts, that they cannot rightly discern.
verses.html:
They know not, neither do they understand; For he hath closed up their eyes, that they cannot see;
And their hearts, that they cannot rightly discern.

verses.text: Neither doth he consider in his heart; Neither hath he knowledge, nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; I have also baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, and eaten it: And shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? Shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?
verses.html:
Neither doth he consider in his heart; Neither hath he knowledge, nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; I have also baked bread upon the coals thereof;
I have roasted flesh, and eaten it:
And shall I make the residue thereof an abomination?
Shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?

verses.text: He feedeth on ashes: a deluded heart leadeth him aside, So that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?
Remember these things, O Jacob, And, Israel; for thou art my servant: I have formed thee; thou art my servant; O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten by me.
I have blotted out as a thick cloud thy transgressions, And as a light cloud thy sins: Return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.

Sing, O ye heavens, for Jehovah hath done it; Utter a joyful sound, ye lower parts of the earth: Burst forth into song, O ye mountains: Thou forest, and every tree therein: For Jehovah hath redeemed Jacob, And will be glorified in Israel.
verses.html:
Sing, O ye heavens, for Jehovah hath done it;
Utter a joyful sound, ye lower parts of the earth:
Burst forth into song, O ye mountains:
Thou forest, and every tree therein:
For Jehovah hath redeemed Jacob,
And will be glorified in Israel.

verses.text: Thus saith Jehovah, thy Redeemer, Even He that formed thee from the womb: I am Jehovah who maketh all things, Who stretcheth out the heavens alone; Who spreadeth abroad the earth by myself:
verses.html:
Thus saith Jehovah, thy Redeemer,
Even He that formed thee from the womb:
I am Jehovah who maketh all things,
Who stretcheth out the heavens alone;
Who spreadeth abroad the earth by myself:

verses.text: I am He who frustrated the foretokens of the impostors, And maketh the diviners mad; Who turneth the wise men backward, And maketh their knowledge foolish:

Who established the word of his servant, And accomplished the counsel of his messengers: Who saith to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; And to the cities of Judah, Ye shall be built; And I will restore her desolate places:
Who saith to the deep, Be dry; And I will make dry thy rivers:
Who saith of Cyrus, He is my shepherd; And he shall fulfill all my pleasure: Who saith of Jerusalem, She shall be built; And to the Temple, Thy foundations shall be laid.

verses.heading: XLV / XLV
verses.text: Thus saith Jehovah to his Anointed, to Cyrus, Whom I hold fast by his right hand; To subdue nations before him, And ungird the loins of kings; To open before him the two-leaved gates: And the gates shall not be shut.
verses.html:
Thus saith Jehovah to his Anointed, to Cyrus,
Whom I hold fast by his right hand;
To subdue nations before him,
And ungird the loins of kings;
To open before him the two-leaved gates:
And the gates shall not be shut.

verses.text: I will go before thee, And make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass. And cut in sunder the bars of iron.
And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, And the stores deeply hidden in secret places; That thou mayest know that I am Jehovah, He who calleth thee by thy name, the God of Israel.
verses.html:
And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, And the stores deeply hidden in secret places;
That thou mayest know that I am Jehovah,
He who calleth thee by thy name, the God of Israel.

verses.text: For Jacob my servant’s sake, And Israel my chosen, I have even called thee by thy name; I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.
I am Jehovah, and there is none else; There is no God beside me: I girded thee, though thou knewest me not;
verses.html:
I am Jehovah, and there is none else;
There is no God beside me:
I girded thee, though thou knewest me not;

verses.text: That men may know from the rising of the sun, And from the west, that there is none beside me; I am Jehovah, and there is none else:
verses.html:
That men may know from the rising of the sun, And from the west, that there is none beside me;
I am Jehovah, and there is none else:

verses.text: I form light, and create darkness; I make peace, and create evil: I Jehovah do all these things.
verses.html:
I form light, and create darkness; I make peace, and create evil:
I Jehovah do all these things.

verses.text: Drop down, ye heavens, from above; And let the clouds shower down righteousness; Let the earth open her bosom, and let them bring forth salvation, And let righteousness spring up together: I Jehovah have created it.
verses.html:
Drop down, ye heavens, from above; And let the clouds shower down righteousness; Let the earth open her bosom, and let them bring forth salvation, And let righteousness spring up together:
I Jehovah have created it.

verses.text: Wo unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let a potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? Or thy work; He hath no hands?
verses.html:
Wo unto him that striveth with his Maker!
Let a potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth.
Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou?
Or thy work; He hath no hands?

verses.text: Wo unto him that saith unto his father, What begettest thou? Or to the woman, What dost thou bring forth?
Thus saith Jehovah, The Holy One of Israel, and his Maker: Of things to come ask me; But over my sons, and over the work of my hands, let me have the command.
verses.html:
Thus saith Jehovah,
The Holy One of Israel, and his Maker:
Of things to come ask me;
But over my sons, and over the work of my hands, let me have the command.

verses.text: I have made the earth, And created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens, And to all the host of them I have given command.
verses.html:
I have made the earth, And created man upon it:
I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens,
And to all the host of them I have given command.

verses.text: I have raised him up in righteousness, And I will make straight all his ways: He shall build my city, and release my captives, Not for price, nor for reward: Saith Jehovah of hosts.
verses.html:
I have raised him up in righteousness, And I will make straight all his ways: He shall build my city, and release my captives, Not for price, nor for reward:
Saith Jehovah of hosts.

verses.text: Thus saith Jehovah: The labour of Egypt, the merchandise of Cush, And of the Sabeans, men of stature; Shall come over unto thee, and shall be thine: They shall follow thee; in chains shall they pass along, And they shall bow down unto thee; They shall make supplication unto thee, saying: Surely God is in thee, and there is none else; There is no God besides.
verses.html:
Thus saith Jehovah:
The labour of Egypt, the merchandise of Cush,
And of the Sabeans, men of stature;
Shall come over unto thee, and shall be thine:
They shall follow thee; in chains shall they pass along,
And they shall bow down unto thee;
They shall make supplication unto thee, saying:
Surely God is in thee, and there is none else;
There is no God besides.

verses.text: Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself; O God of Israel, the Saviour!
They are ashamed, and also confounded, all of them; They retire in confusion together that are makers of images.
But Israel shall be saved through Jehovah with an everlasting salvation: Ye shall not be ashamed, nor confounded, world without end.
verses.html:
But Israel shall be saved through Jehovah with an everlasting salvation:
Ye shall not be ashamed, nor confounded, world without end.

verses.text: For thus saith Jehovah who created the heavens; He himself is the God who formed the earth, and made it; it was He that hath established it; He created it not in vain; He formed it to be inhabited: I am Jehovah, and there is none else.
verses.html:
For thus saith Jehovah who created the heavens;
He himself is the God who formed the earth, and made it; it was He that hath established it;
He created it not in vain; He formed it to be inhabited:
I am Jehovah, and there is none else.

verses.text: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth; I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain: I, Jehovah, speak the truth: I declare the things that are right
verses.html:
I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth; I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain:
I, Jehovah, speak the truth: I declare the things that are right

verses.text: Assemble yourselves and come; Gather yourselves together, ye that are escaped of the nations: They have no knowledge that carry about the wood of their graven image, And pray to a god that cannot save.

Publish it abroad, and bring them near; yea, let them take counsel together: Who hath made this known from ancient time, hath declared it of old? Was it not I, Jehovah? besides me there is no God; A just God, and a Saviour; there is none beside me.
verses.html:
Publish it abroad, and bring them near; yea, let them take counsel together: Who hath made this known from ancient time, hath declared it of old?
Was it not I, Jehovah? besides me there is no God;
A just God, and a Saviour; there is none beside me.

verses.text: Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth: For I am God, and there is none else.
I have sworn by myself, the truth is gone out of my mouth; The word, and it shall not be revoked: That unto me every knee shall bow, Every tongue shall swear.
Only in Jehovah, shall one say of me, is righteousness and strength; To Him shall men come, And all that are incensed against Him shall be ashamed.
verses.html:
Only in Jehovah, shall one say of me, is righteousness and strength;
To Him shall men come,
And all that are incensed against Him shall be ashamed.

verses.text: In Jehovah shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.
verses.html: In Jehovah shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.

verses.heading: XLVI / XLVI
verses.text: Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth; Their idols are laid upon the beasts, and upon the cattle: What were borne by you are made into loads, A burden to the weary beast.
They stoop, they bow down together: They are not able to deliver the burden; But they themselves go into captivity.
Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, And all the remnant of the house of Israel; Ye that have been borne by me from the belly, That have been carried from the womb.
And even to your old age, I am the same; And even to your gray hairs, I will carry you: I have made, arid I will bear; Even I will carry, and will deliver you.
To whom will ye liken me, and equal me? And to whom will ye compare me, that we may be like?
They lavish gold out of the bag, And weigh silver in the balance; They hire a goldsmith, and he maketh it a god: They fall down; yea, they worship him.

They bear him upon the shoulder; they carry him about; They set him down in his place, and he standeth: From his place shall he not remove; Yea, one shall cry unto him, but he will not answer; Nor save him from his trouble.
Remember this, and shew yourselves men: Bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.
Remember the former things, of old time: For I am God, arid there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me:
Declaring the end from the beginning, And from ancient times, the things that are not yet done; Saying: My counsel shall stand: And I will do all my pleasure:
Calling a ravenous bird from the east, And the man of my counsel from a far country: Yea, I have spoken it, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed it; I will also do it.
Hearken unto me, ye stubborn in heart, Ye that are far from righteousness:
I will bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off; And my salvation shall not tarry: I will place salvation in Zion, For Israel my glory.

verses.heading: XLVII / XLVII
verses.text: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon I Sit on the ground, without a throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: For thou shalt no longer be called the tender, and the delicate.
Take the mill, and grind meal: Take off thy veil, take up the train of thy garment; Make bare thy leg; wade through the rivers.
Thy nakedness shall be disclosed; yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and will not spare a man.
Thus saith our Redeemer, Jehovah of hosts is his name, The Holy One of Israel:
verses.html:
Thus saith our Redeemer, Jehovah of hosts is his name,
The Holy One of Israel:

verses.text: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans; For thou shalt no longer be called. The lady of Kingdoms.
I was angry with my people, I polluted mine inheritance, And gave them up into thine hand: Thou didst shew them no mercy; Upon the aged didst thou very heavily lay thy yoke.
And thou saidst: I shall be a lady for ever: So that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, Neither didst thou think upon the latter end thereof.
verses.html:
And thou saidst: I shall be a lady for ever:
So that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart,
Neither didst thou think upon the latter end thereof.

verses.text: Now, therefore, hear this, O thou voluptuous, that sittest in security: Thou that sayest in thine heart: I am, and there is none besides; I shall not sit a widow; neither shall I know the loss of children.

Yet these two things shall come to thee in a moment, In one day, loss of children and widowhood: They shall come upon thee in their perfection, Notwithstanding the multitude of thy sorceries; Notwithstanding the great strength of thine enchantments.
But thou didst trust in thy wickedness, and saidst: None seeth me. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, they perverted thee; So that thou saidst in thine heart: I am, and there is none besides.

Therefore shall evil come upon thee, The dawn whereof thou shalt not perceive; And mischief shall fall upon thee, Which thou shalt not be able to expiate; And destruction shall come upon thee suddenly, of which thou shalt have no apprehension.
Persist now in thine enchantments, And in the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; Perhaps thou mayest be able to profit, Perhaps thou mayest prevail.

Thou art wearied in the multiplicity of thy counsels: Let them stand up now, and save thee, The astrologers, the gazers on the stars; They that prognosticate at every new moon What are the events that shall happen unto thee.
Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them up; They shall not deliver their own souls from the power of the flame: There shall not be a coal to warm at, Nor a fire to sit before it.
verses.html:
Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them up; They shall not deliver their own souls from the power of the flame: There shall not be a coal to warm at,
Nor a fire to sit before it.

verses.text: Thus will they prove to be unto thee, amongst whom thou hast laboured, Those with whom thou hast had dealing from thy youth: They shall become bewildered, every one in his quarter; Not one will there be to save thee.

verses.heading: XLVIII / XLVIII
verses.text: Hear this, O house of Jacob, Ye that are called by the name of Israel, Ye that flow from the fountain of Judah; Ye that swear by the name of Jehovah, And make mention of the God of Israel; But not in sincerity, nor in truth.
verses.html:
Hear this, O house of Jacob, Ye that are called by the name of Israel, Ye that flow from the fountain of Judah;
Ye that swear by the name of Jehovah,
And make mention of the God of Israel;
But not in sincerity, nor in truth.

verses.text: For they take their name from the Holy City, And stay themselves upon the God of Israel; Jehovah of hosts is his name.
verses.html:
For they take their name from the Holy City, And stay themselves upon the God of Israel;
Jehovah of hosts is his name.

verses.text: The former events I declared of old; Yea, from my mouth they proceeded, and I made them known: On a sudden I effected them, and they came to pass.
Because I knew that thou wast obstinate, And thy neck was an iron sinew, And thy forehead brass;

Therefore I declared them to thee of old; Before they came to pass I made them known to thee; Lest thou shouldest say: Mine idol effected them; And my graven image, and my molten image, hath ordered them.
Thou hast heard; have now regard to the whole of it: And will ye not acknowledge it? From this time I will make thee hear new things; Even hitherto secret, so that thou couldest not have known them.
They are produced now, and not of old; And before this day thou hast not heard of them: Lest thou shouldest say: Behold, I knew them.
Yea, thou hast not heard; yea, thou hast not known; Yea, from of old thine ear was not opened: For I knew that thou wouldest certainly deal falsely, And that Apostate was thy name from the womb.
For my name's sake I will defer mine anger; And for the sake of my praise I will withhold it from thee, That I may not utterly cut thee off.
Behold, I have purified thee in the fire, but not as silver; I have tried thee in the furnace of affliction.
verses.html:
Behold, I have purified thee in the fire, but not as silver;
I have tried thee in the furnace of affliction.

verses.text: For mine own sake, even for mine own sake, will I do it; for how should my name be profaned? And I will not give my glory unto another.
verses.html:
For mine own sake, even for mine own sake, will I do it; for how should my name be profaned?
And I will not give my glory unto another.

verses.text: Hearken unto me, O Jacob, And Israel, whom I have called: I am He; I am the first; I also am the last.
Yea, my hand hath founded the earth, And my right hand hath expanded the heavens; When I summon them; they present themselves together.
Gather yourselves together all of you, and hear: Who among you hath declared these things? He, whom Jehovah hath loved, will execute his pleasure on Babylon, And his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.
verses.html:
Gather yourselves together all of you, and hear: Who among you hath declared these things?
He, whom Jehovah hath loved, will execute his pleasure on Babylon,
And his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.

verses.text: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and his way shall be prosperous.
verses.html:
I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him:
I have brought him, and his way shall be prosperous.

verses.text: Draw ye near unto me, and hear this: I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; From the time that it existed, there am I: And now the Lord Jehovah hath sent me, and his Spirit
verses.html:
Draw ye near unto me, and hear this: I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; From the time that it existed, there am I:
And now the Lord Jehovah hath sent me, and his Spirit

verses.text: Thus saith Jehovah, Thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I am Jehovah, thy God, Who teacheth thee what will tend to thy profit; Who directeth thee in the way wherein thou shouldest go.
verses.html:
Thus saith Jehovah,
Thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel;
I am Jehovah, thy God,
Who teacheth thee what will tend to thy profit;
Who directeth thee in the way wherein thou shouldest go.

verses.text: O that thou hadst attended to my commandments! Then had thy peace been like a river, And thy righteousness as the waves of the sea.
Thy seed also had been as the sand of the sea, And the offspring of thy bowels as the produce of the bowels thereof; It should not have been cut off, Neither its name been destroyed from before me.
verses.html:
Thy seed also had been as the sand of the sea,
And the offspring of thy bowels as the produce of the bowels thereof;
It should not have been cut off,
Neither its name been destroyed from before me.

verses.text: Go ye forth from Babylon, Flee ye from the Chaldeans with the voice of joy: Publish ye this, make it to be heard, Utter it forth even to the end of the earth; Say ye: Jehovah hath redeemed his servant Jacob,
verses.html:
Go ye forth from Babylon, Flee ye from the Chaldeans with the voice of joy: Publish ye this, make it to be heard, Utter it forth even to the end of the earth;
Say ye: Jehovah hath redeemed his servant Jacob,

verses.text: And they thirsted not in the desert, through which He led them; He caused the waters to flow from the rock for them: Yea, He clave the rock, and the waters gushed out.
There is no peace, saith Jehovah, to the wicked.
verses.html: There is no peace, saith Jehovah, to the wicked.

verses.heading: XLIX / XLIX
verses.text: Listen, O isles, unto me; And hearken, ye people, from far; Jehovah hath called me from the womb, From the bowels of my mother hath He made mention of my name.
verses.html:
Listen, O isles, unto me; And hearken, ye people, from far;
Jehovah hath called me from the womb,
From the bowels of my mother hath He made mention of my name.

verses.text: And He hath made my mouth like a sharp sword, In the shadow of his hand hath He concealed me; Yea, He hath made me a polished arrow, In his quiver hath He hid me:
And He said unto me: Thou art my servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.
But I said: I have laboured in vain; For nought, and for vanity, have I spent my strength: Nevertheless my right is with Jehovah, And the reward of my work with my God.
verses.html:
But I said: I have laboured in vain; For nought, and for vanity, have I spent my strength:
Nevertheless my right is with Jehovah,
And the reward of my work with my God.

verses.text: And now, saith Jehovah Who hath formed me from the womb to be his servant, To bring Jacob again unto him, And that Israel unto him may be gathered: For I am glorious in the eyes of Jehovah, And my God is my strength.
verses.html:
And now, saith Jehovah
Who hath formed me from the womb to be his servant,
To bring Jacob again unto him,
And that Israel unto him may be gathered:
For I am glorious in the eyes of Jehovah,
And my God is my strength.

verses.text: Yea, He said: It is too light a thing that thou shouldest be my servant To raise up the tribes of Jacob, And to restore the saved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the nations, To be my salvation unto the end of the earth.

Thus saith Jehovah, The Redeemer of Israel, his Holy One, To him who is despised of men; to him whom the nation abhorreth; To the servant of rulers: Kings shall see, and shall rise up; Princes, and they shall bow themselves: Because of Jehovah who is faithful, The Holy One of Israel, who hath chosen thee.
verses.html:
Thus saith Jehovah,
The Redeemer of Israel, his Holy One,
To him who is despised of men; to him whom the nation abhorreth;
To the servant of rulers:
Kings shall see, and shall rise up;
Princes, and they shall bow themselves:
Because of Jehovah who is faithful,
The Holy One of Israel, who hath chosen thee.

verses.text: Thus saith Jehovah: In time of grace will I hear thee, And in the day of salvation will I help thee; And I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, To restore the land, to give possession of the desolate heritages:
verses.html:
Thus saith Jehovah:
In time of grace will I hear thee,
And in the day of salvation will I help thee;
And I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people,
To restore the land, to give possession of the desolate heritages:

verses.text: To say to the bounden, Go forth; To those that are in darkness, Come into light They shall feed beside the ways, And on all the eminences shall be their pasture.
They shall not hunger, nor thirst; Neither shall the glowing heat, nor the sun, smite them: For He that hath mercy on them shall lead them, And shall guide them to the fountains of water.
And I will make all my mountains an even way, And my causeways shall be raised on high.
Behold! these shall come from far; And, lo! these from the north and from the west; And these from the land of Sinim.
Sing, O ye heavens! and be joyful, O earth! And burst forth into song, O mountains! For Jehovah hath comforted his people, And hath had mercy on his afflicted.
verses.html:
Sing, O ye heavens! and be joyful, O earth! And burst forth into song, O mountains!
For Jehovah hath comforted his people,
And hath had mercy on his afflicted.

verses.text: But Zion saith: Jehovah hath forsaken me, And the Lord hath forgotten me.
verses.html:
But Zion saith: Jehovah hath forsaken me,
And the Lord hath forgotten me.

verses.text: Can a woman forget her suckling, That she should have no compassion on the son of her womb? Yea, they may forget; Yet I will not forget thee.
Behold! I have graven thee on the palms of my hands; Thy walls are ever before me.
Thy sons shall make haste: Thy destroyers, and they that made thee waste, shall depart from thee.

Lift up thine eyes around, and see; All these are gathered together, they come to thee. As I live, saith Jehovah, Thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all, as with an ornament; And bind them on thee as a bride doeth.
verses.html:
Lift up thine eyes around, and see; All these are gathered together, they come to thee.
As I live, saith Jehovah,
Thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all, as with an ornament;
And bind them on thee as a bride doeth.

verses.text: For in thy waste, and in thy desolate places, And in thy land that is destroyed, Even now shalt thou be straitened by reason of the inhabitants; And they that devoured thee shall be removed far away.
Moreover, thy sons, of whom thou wast bereaved, shall say in thine ears: This place is too strait for me; make way for me that I may dwell.

Then shalt thou say in thine heart: Who hath begotten me these? I was childless and barren; An exile, and an outcast; who then hath nursed these up? Behold, I was left alone; these then, where were they?

Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will lift up mine hand to the nations, And set up my standard to the people; And they shall bring thy sons in their bosom, And thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.
verses.html:
Thus saith the Lord Jehovah:
Behold, I will lift up mine hand to the nations,
And set up my standard to the people;
And they shall bring thy sons in their bosom,
And thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.

verses.text: And kings shall be thy nourishers, And their queens thy nurses; They shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth, And shall lick up the dust of thy feet; And thou shalt know that I am Jehovah: For they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.
verses.html:
And kings shall be thy nourishers, And their queens thy nurses;
They shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth,
And shall lick up the dust of thy feet;
And thou shalt know that I am Jehovah:
For they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.

verses.text: Shall the spoil be taken away from the mighty? Or shall the captive seized by right of strength be rescued?

Yea, thus saith Jehovah: Even the captive seized by the mighty shall be retaken, And the spoil seized by the terrible shall be rescued: For I will contend with him that contends with thee, And I will save thy children.
verses.html:
Yea, thus saith Jehovah:
Even the captive seized by the mighty shall be retaken,
And the spoil seized by the terrible shall be rescued:
For I will contend with him that contends with thee,
And I will save thy children.

verses.text: And I will gorge thine oppressors with their own flesh; And with their own blood, as with new wine, shall they be drunken: And all flesh shall know That I Jehovah am thy Saviour, And that thy Redeemer is the Mighty One of Jacob.
verses.html:
And I will gorge thine oppressors with their own flesh; And with their own blood, as with new wine, shall they be drunken: And all flesh shall know
That I Jehovah am thy Saviour,
And that thy Redeemer is the Mighty One of Jacob.

verses.heading: L / L
verses.text: Thus saith Jehovah: Where is the bill of your mother’s divorcement, By which I have dismissed her? Or who is he among my creditors, To whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities are ye sold; And for your transgressions is your mother dismissed.
verses.html:
Thus saith Jehovah:
Where is the bill of your mother’s divorcement,
By which I have dismissed her?
Or who is he among my creditors,
To whom I have sold you?
Behold, for your iniquities are ye sold;
And for your transgressions is your mother dismissed.

verses.text: Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? When I called, was there none to answer? Is mine hand indeed shortened, that it cannot redeem? And have I no power to deliver? Behold, at my rebuke I made dry the sea, I made the rivers a desert: Their fish stinketh, because there is no water; And dieth away for thirst.
I clothe the heavens with blackness; And I make sackcloth their covering.

The Lord Jehovah hath given me the tongue of the learned, That I might know how to speak a word in season to the weary. He wnkeneth morning by morning, He wakeneth mine ear to hearken with the attention of a learner.
verses.html:
The Lord Jehovah hath given me the tongue of the learned,
That I might know how to speak a word in season to the weary.
He wnkeneth morning by morning,
He wakeneth mine ear to hearken with the attention of a learner.

verses.text: The Lord Jehovah hath opened mine ear, And I was not rebellious; Neither turned away back.
verses.html:
The Lord Jehovah hath opened mine ear,
And I was not rebellious;
Neither turned away back.

verses.text: I gave my back to the smiters, And my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
For the Lord Jehovah will help me; Therefore I shall not be ashamed: Therefore I set my face like a flint, For I know that I shall not be confounded.
verses.html:
For the Lord Jehovah will help me;
Therefore I shall not be ashamed:
Therefore I set my face like a flint,
For I know that I shall not be confounded.

verses.text: He is near that justifieth me; Who is he that will contend with me? let us stand forth together: Who is mine adversary? let him come near to me.
Behold, the Lord Jehovah will help me; Who is he that shall condemn me? Lo! they all shall wax old as a garment; The moth shall eat them up.
verses.html:
Behold, the Lord Jehovah will help me;
Who is he that shall condemn me?
Lo! they all shall wax old as a garment;
The moth shall eat them up.

verses.text: Who is there among you that feareth Jehovah, That hearkeneth unto the voice of his servant, That walketh in darkness, and hath no light? Let him trust in the name of Jehovah; And stay himself upon his God.
verses.html:
Who is there among you that feareth Jehovah,
That hearkeneth unto the voice of his servant,
That walketh in darkness, and hath no light?
Let him trust in the name of Jehovah;
And stay himself upon his God.

verses.text: Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, Who are begirt with combustible materials: Walk ye in the light of your fire, And amid the combustible materials which ye have kindled. From my hand shall this befall you; In sorrow ye shall lie down.

verses.heading: LI / LI
verses.text: Hearken unto me, ye that follow after righteousness, Ye that seek Jehovah: Look unto the rock, from whence ye were hewn, And to the hole of the pit, whence ye were digged.
verses.html:
Hearken unto me, ye that follow after righteousness,
Ye that seek Jehovah:
Look unto the rock, from whence ye were hewn,
And to the hole of the pit, whence ye were digged.

verses.text: Look unto Abraham your father, And unto Sarah, who bare you: For I called him, being then one, And blessed him, and multiplied him.

For Jehovah shall comfort Zion; He will comfort all her desolate places: And He will make her wilderness like Eden, And her desert like the garden of Jehovah: Joy and gladness shall be found in her, Thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.
verses.html:
For Jehovah shall comfort Zion;
He will comfort all her desolate places:
And He will make her wilderness like Eden,
And her desert like the garden of Jehovah:
Joy and gladness shall be found in her,
Thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.

verses.text: Attend unto me, my people; And give ear unto me, O my nation: For a law shall proceed from me, And my judgment will I establish for a light of the people.
My righteousness is near, my salvation is gone forth; And mine arm shall judge the people; The isles shall wait upon me, And on mine arm shall they trust

Lift up your eyes to the heavens, And look upon the earth beneath: For the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, And the earth shall wax old like a garment, And the inhabitants thereof shall die off like insects; But my solvation shall be for ever, And my righteousness shall not be abolished.
Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, The people in whose heart is my law; Fear ye not the reproach of men, Neither be ye borne down by their revilings:
For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, And the worm shall eat them like wool: But my righteousness shall be for ever, And my salvation from generation to generation.
Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of Jehovah! Awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. Art thou not it that cut Rahab, and wounded the dragon?
verses.html:
Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of Jehovah!
Awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old.
Art thou not it that cut Rahab, and wounded the dragon?

verses.text: Art thou not it which dried the sea, the waters of the great deep? That made the depths of the sea a path for the redeemed to pass over?
Thus shall the ransomed of Jehovah return, And come with singing unto Zion; And everlasting joy shall be upon their head: They shall obtain gladness and joy, And sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
verses.html:
Thus shall the ransomed of Jehovah return,
And come with singing unto Zion;
And everlasting joy shall be upon their head:
They shall obtain gladness and joy,
And sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

verses.text: I, even I, am he that comforteth you: Who art thou, that thou shouldest be afraid of man that shall die, And of the son of man, who shall be made as grass?

And shouldest forget Jehovah thy maker, Who hath stretched out the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; And shouldest fear continually, every day, Because of the fury of the oppressor, As if he were ready to destroy: And where is the fury of the oppressor?
verses.html:
And shouldest forget Jehovah thy maker,
Who hath stretched out the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth;
And shouldest fear continually, every day,
Because of the fury of the oppressor,
As if he were ready to destroy:
And where is the fury of the oppressor?

verses.text: The bound prisoner shall soon be released: He shall not die in the pit, Neither shall his bread fail.
For I am Jehovah thy God, He who setteth the sea in commotion, so that the waves thereof roar: Jehovah of hosts is his name.
verses.html:
For I am Jehovah thy God,
He who setteth the sea in commotion, so that the waves thereof roar:
Jehovah of hosts is his name.

verses.text: I have put my words in thy mouth, And with the shadow of my hand have I covered thee: That I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, And say unto Zion: Thou art my people.
Awake, awake; stand up, O Jerusalem! Which hast drunk from the hand of Jehovah the cup of his fury: The dregs of the cup of dizziness, hast thou drunk; thou hast wrung them out.
verses.html:
Awake, awake; stand up, O Jerusalem!
Which hast drunk from the hand of Jehovah the cup of his fury:
The dregs of the cup of dizziness, hast thou drunk; thou hast wrung them out.

verses.text: There is not one to guide her of all the sons which she hath brought forth; Neither is there one to support her by the hand, of all the sons which she hath brought up.
These two things have befallen thee, who shall bemoan thee? Desolation and destruction; and the famine and the sword; by whom shall I comfort thee?
Thy sons have fainted away; they lie down at the head of all the streets, As a stag in a net; They are full of the fury of Jehovah, the rebuke of thy God.
verses.html:
Thy sons have fainted away; they lie down at the head of all the streets, As a stag in a net;
They are full of the fury of Jehovah, the rebuke of thy God.

verses.text: Wherefore hear now this, thou afflicted, And drunken, but not with wine.
Thus saith thy Lord, Jehovah, And thy God, who pleadeth the cause of his people; Behold! I take from thy hand the cup of dizziness, The dregs of the cup of my fury; Thou shalt no more drink it again.
verses.html:
Thus saith thy Lord, Jehovah,
And thy God, who pleadeth the cause of his people;
Behold! I take from thy hand the cup of dizziness,
The dregs of the cup of my fury;
Thou shalt no more drink it again.

verses.text: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee, Who have said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over: And thou madest thy back as the ground, And as the street, to them that passed over.

verses.heading: LII / LII
verses.text: Awake, awake; put on thy strength, O Zion! Put on thy beautiful garments, O Jerusalem! the holy city; For there shall no more come unto thee the uncircumcised, and the unclean.
Shake thyself from the dust, arise, and sit down, O Jerusalem! Loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion!
verses.html:
Shake thyself from the dust, arise, and sit down, O Jerusalem!
Loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion!

verses.text: For thus saith Jehovah: For nought have ye been sold, And not with money shall ye be ransomed,
verses.html:
For thus saith Jehovah:
For nought have ye been sold,
And not with money shall ye be ransomed,

verses.text: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there; And the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.
verses.html:
For thus saith the Lord Jehovah:
My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there;
And the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.

verses.text: And now, what have I to do here, saith Jehovah, Seeing that my people is taken away for nought? They that rule over them howl, saith Jehovah, And continually, every day, is my name blasphemed.
verses.html:
And now, what have I to do here, saith Jehovah,
Seeing that my people is taken away for nought?
They that rule over them howl, saith Jehovah,
And continually, every day, is my name blasphemed.

verses.text: Therefore my people shall know my name; Therefore they shall know in that day That I am He that doth speak: behold, it is I.
verses.html:
Therefore my people shall know my name;
Therefore they shall know in that day
That I am He that doth speak: behold, it is I.

verses.text: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, That publisheth peace, that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; That saith unto Zion: Thy God reigneth!
The voice of thy watchmen! they lift up the voice; they shout for joy together: For they shall see eye to eye, When Jehovah restoreth Zion.
verses.html:
The voice of thy watchmen! they lift up the voice; they shout for joy together: For they shall see eye to eye,
When Jehovah restoreth Zion.

verses.text: Break out into singing, shout for joy together, Ye waste places of Jerusalem! For Jehovah hath comforted his people, He hath redeemed Jerusalem.
verses.html:
Break out into singing, shout for joy together, Ye waste places of Jerusalem!
For Jehovah hath comforted his people,
He hath redeemed Jerusalem.

verses.text: Jehovah hath made bare his holy arm before the eyes of all the nations; And all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.
verses.html:
Jehovah hath made bare his holy arm before the eyes of all the nations;
And all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.

verses.text: Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence; Touch no unclean thing: Go ye out from the midst of her; Be ye clean, ye that bear the vessels of Jehovah!
verses.html:
Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence; Touch no unclean thing: Go ye out from the midst of her;
Be ye clean, ye that bear the vessels of Jehovah!

verses.text: For ye shall not go out with haste, Nor march along by flight; For Jehovah will go before you, And the God of Israel shall bring up your rear.
verses.html:
For ye shall not go out with haste, Nor march along by flight;
For Jehovah will go before you,
And the God of Israel shall bring up your rear.

verses.text: Behold! my servant shall prosper; He shall be exalted, and extolled, and be very high.
As many were astonished at thee, (His visage was disfigured more than any man, And his form more than the sons of men:)
So shall he sprinkle many nations: Kings shall shut their mouths on account of him; For what had not been told them, they shall see; And what they had not heard, they shall perceive.

verses.heading: LIII / LIII
verses.text: Who hath believed our report, And to whom hath the arm of Jehovah been revealed?
verses.html:
Who hath believed our report,
And to whom hath the arm of Jehovah been revealed?

verses.text: For he grew up like a tender plant before him, And like a root out of a dry ground: He had neither form nor splendour that we should regard him; Nor yet an appearance, that we should desire him.
He was despised and abandoned by men, A man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief, And as one that hideth his face from us: He was despised, and we esteemed him not.
But it was our infirmities that he bare, And our sorrows that he carried: Yet we did esteem him stricken, Smitten of God, and afflicted.
And he was wounded for our transgressions, He was bruised for our iniquities: The chastisement of our peace was upon him, And with his stripes we are healed.
All we, like sheep, have gone astray; We have turned every one to his own way; But Jehovah hath made to meet on him the iniquity of us all:
verses.html:
All we, like sheep, have gone astray; We have turned every one to his own way;
But Jehovah hath made to meet on him the iniquity of us all:

verses.text: He was oppressed, and he submitted himself, and opened not his mouth: He was led as a lamb to the slaughter; And as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, So he opened not his mouth.
He was taken from prison and from judgment: And who shall declare his generation? For he was cut off from the land of the living; For the transgression of my people was he stricken.
And his grave was appointed with the wicked; But it was with the rich at his death, Because he had done no violence; Neither was any deceit in his mouth.

But Jehovah was pleased to bruise him; He put him to grief: If his soul shall make an offering for sin, He shall see seed; he shall prolong days, And the pleasure of Jehovah shall prosper in his hands.
verses.html:
But Jehovah was pleased to bruise him; He put him to grief:
If his soul shall make an offering for sin,
He shall see seed; he shall prolong days,
And the pleasure of Jehovah shall prosper in his hands.

verses.text: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied; By the knowledge of him my righteous servant shall justify many; For he shall bear their iniquities.
verses.html:
He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied;
By the knowledge of him my righteous servant shall justify many;
For he shall bear their iniquities.

verses.text: Therefore will I distribute to him the many for his portion, And he shall distribute the strong as a spoil; Because he poured out his soul unto death, And was numbered with the transgressors; And he bare the sin of many, And made intercession for the transgressors.

verses.heading: LIV / LIV
verses.text: Shout for joy, O barren, thou that didst not bear; Break forth into singing, and shout, thou that didst not travail: For more are the children of the desolate, Than the children of the married wife, saith Jehovah.
verses.html:
Shout for joy, O barren, thou that didst not bear; Break forth into singing, and shout, thou that didst not travail: For more are the children of the desolate,
Than the children of the married wife, saith Jehovah.

verses.text: Enlarge the place of thy tent; And let the curtains of thine habitations be extended; spare not: Lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes.
For thou shalt break forth on the right hand, and on the left; And thy seed shall inherit the nations, And make the desolate cities to be inhabited.

Fear not, for thou shalt not be ashamed; Neither be thou confounded, for thou shalt not be put to shame: For thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, And the reproach of thy widowhood thou shalt remember no more.
For thy Maker is thine husband, Jehovah of hosts is his name; And thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: The God of the whole earth shall He be called.
verses.html:
For thy Maker is thine husband,
Jehovah of hosts is his name;
And thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel:
The God of the whole earth shall He be called.

verses.text: For Jehovah hath called thee as a woman forsaken, and grieved in spirit; And as a wife of youth, when she was rejected, saith thy God.
verses.html:
For Jehovah hath called thee as a woman forsaken, and grieved in spirit;
And as a wife of youth, when she was rejected, saith thy God.

verses.text: For a short moment have I forsaken thee; But with great mercies will I gather thee.
In vehemence of wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; But with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, Saith thy Redeemer, Jehovah.
verses.html:
In vehemence of wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; But with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee,
Saith thy Redeemer, Jehovah.

verses.text: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me, When I sware that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; So have I sworn that I will not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.
verses.html:
For this is as the waters of Noah unto me,
When I sware that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth;
So have I sworn that I will not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.

verses.text: For the mountains shall depart, And the hills be removed; But my kindness shall not depart from thee, Neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed; Saith Jehovah, who hath mercy on thee.
verses.html:
For the mountains shall depart, And the hills be removed; But my kindness shall not depart from thee, Neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed;
Saith Jehovah, who hath mercy on thee.
